---
title: "Tech Value: Over & under performers"
page-layout: full
toc: false
body-classes: tv-page
---

<style>
body {
  --op-ink:var(--tv-ink); --op-muted:var(--tv-muted); --op-line:var(--tv-line); --op-surface:var(--tv-surface);
  --op-teal:var(--tv-teal); --op-neg:#c2414d; --op-chip:var(--tv-chip);
  --op-k1-bg:#eaf6f6; --op-k1-line:#bfe0df; --op-k2-bg:#e6f7ef; --op-k2-line:#a9e3cb;
  --op-k3-bg:#fdf3e1; --op-k3-line:#f1d48f; --op-k4-bg:#fbeaea; --op-k4-line:#efc4c4;
  --op-k3-ink:#8a4b08; --op-k4-ink:#7a1f24; --op-callout:#dcf5ea; --op-warn:#b45309;
}
body.quarto-dark {
  --op-neg:#f0a3a8;
  --op-k1-bg:#132a2c; --op-k1-line:#22494b; --op-k2-bg:#14302a; --op-k2-line:#245647;
  --op-k3-bg:#33290f; --op-k3-line:#5c4818; --op-k4-bg:#3a1d20; --op-k4-line:#5e2f33;
  --op-k3-ink:#f2c46d; --op-k4-ink:#f0a3a8; --op-callout:#18392f; --op-warn:#f2b23a;
}
main.content { color:var(--op-ink) }
main.content p { margin-bottom:0 }
.op-ico { width:1.15em; height:1.15em; flex:none; vertical-align:-.2em; stroke:currentColor; fill:none; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round }

/* Coverage line and KPI cards */
.op-head { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:baseline; gap:4px 14px; margin:14px 0 4px; padding:12px 16px; border-radius:12px; border:1px solid var(--op-k1-line); background:var(--op-k1-bg) }
.op-head strong { font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2rem); font-weight:700; line-height:1.1; color:var(--op-ink); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums }
.op-head .op-head-label { font-size:1rem; font-weight:700 }
.op-head .op-head-sub { flex-basis:100%; color:var(--op-muted); font-size:.86rem; line-height:1.45 }
.op-kpis { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:14px; margin:14px 0 6px }
.op-kpi { padding:14px 18px; border-radius:12px; border:1px solid }
.op-kpi strong { display:block; font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3vw,2.1rem); font-weight:700; line-height:1.1; color:var(--op-ink) }
.op-kpi span { display:block; margin-top:4px; font-size:.92rem; line-height:1.3 }
.op-kpi small { display:block; margin-top:2px; color:var(--op-muted); font-size:.78rem }
.op-kpi:nth-child(1) { background:var(--op-k1-bg); border-color:var(--op-k1-line) }
.op-kpi:nth-child(2) { background:var(--op-k2-bg); border-color:var(--op-k2-line) }
.op-kpi:nth-child(3) { background:var(--op-k3-bg); border-color:var(--op-k3-line) }
.op-kpi:nth-child(3) strong { color:var(--op-k3-ink) }
.op-kpi:nth-child(4) { background:var(--op-k4-bg); border-color:var(--op-k4-line) }
.op-kpi:nth-child(4) strong { color:var(--op-k4-ink) }
.op-note { color:var(--op-muted); font-size:.86rem; margin:0 2px 16px; line-height:1.45 }

/* Find a product */
.op-find { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:8px 14px; margin:6px 0 4px }
.op-find label { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:6px 10px; flex:1 1 320px; min-width:0; font-weight:600; font-size:.92rem }
.op-find input { flex:1 1 200px; min-width:0; max-width:460px; padding:7px 10px; border:1px solid var(--op-line); border-radius:8px; background:var(--op-surface); color:var(--op-ink); font:inherit; font-size:.92rem }
.op-find-msg { flex-basis:100%; color:var(--op-muted); font-size:.84rem }

/* Cards */
.op-card { border:1px solid var(--op-line); border-radius:14px; background:var(--op-surface); padding:clamp(14px,2.2vw,20px); margin-bottom:16px; min-width:0 }
.op-card h2 { margin:0 0 .25rem; padding:0; border:0; font-size:clamp(1.1rem,2.1vw,1.35rem); font-weight:700; color:var(--op-ink) }
.op-card .op-lede { color:var(--op-muted); line-height:1.45; font-size:.92rem }
.op-card .op-foot, .op-foot { color:var(--op-muted); font-size:.8rem; margin-top:6px; line-height:1.4 }
.op-main-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 250px; gap:0 20px; margin-top:8px }
.op-main-grid > * { min-width:0 }
.op-legend { border-left:1px solid var(--op-line); padding:6px 0 6px 18px; font-size:.84rem }
.op-legend ul { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0 }
.op-legend li { display:flex; gap:10px; margin:0 0 12px; line-height:1.3 }
.op-legend li b { display:block; font-size:.92rem }
.op-legend small { display:block; color:var(--op-muted); font-size:.78rem }
.op-dot { width:13px; height:13px; border-radius:50%; flex:none; margin-top:3px }
.op-legend hr { border:0; border-top:1px solid var(--op-line); margin:6px 0 12px; opacity:1 }
.op-legend .op-callout { margin-top:12px; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:8px; background:var(--op-callout); font-weight:600; line-height:1.35 }

/* Peer filters */
.op-peers { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:6px 10px; margin:10px 0 2px; font-size:.84rem; color:var(--op-muted) }
.op-peers select, .op-peers input { max-width:100%; padding:4px 7px; border:1px solid var(--op-line); border-radius:8px; background:var(--op-surface); color:var(--op-ink); font:inherit; font-size:.84rem }
.op-peers input { width:5.5em }
.op-peer-range { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; flex-wrap:wrap }
.op-peer-reset { border:0; background:none; color:var(--op-teal); font:inherit; text-decoration:underline; cursor:pointer; padding:0 }
.op-peer-count { flex-basis:100%; color:var(--op-ink); font-weight:600 }

/* Two-product comparison */
.op-cmp-pick { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px 16px; margin:10px 0 8px; font-size:.84rem; color:var(--op-muted) }
.op-cmp-pick label { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; min-width:0; flex:1 1 220px }
.op-cmp-pick input { padding:6px 9px; border:1px solid var(--op-line); border-radius:8px; background:var(--op-surface); color:var(--op-ink); font:inherit; font-size:.9rem; min-width:0 }
.op-cmp-table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:.88rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums }
.op-cmp-table th, .op-cmp-table td { text-align:left; padding:6px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--op-line); vertical-align:top }
.op-cmp-table th { color:var(--op-muted); font-weight:600; font-size:.8rem }
.op-cmp-table td:first-child { color:var(--op-muted) }
.op-cmp-table small { display:block; color:var(--op-muted) }
.op-cmp-table tr.op-cmp-sec th { padding-top:14px; color:var(--op-ink); font-size:.86rem; font-weight:700; border-bottom:2px solid var(--op-line) }
.op-cmp-table tr.op-cmp-sec th small { display:inline; font-weight:400; margin-left:6px }
.op-cmp-sum { margin:10px 0 0; font-size:.92rem; line-height:1.45 }
.op-cmp-wrap { overflow-x:auto }

/* Product lists (in the collapsible sections) */
.op-tl-bar { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:6px 10px; margin:8px 0 6px; font-size:.84rem; color:var(--op-muted) }
.op-tl-bar select, .op-tl-bar input { max-width:100%; padding:4px 7px; border:1px solid var(--op-line); border-radius:8px; background:var(--op-surface); color:var(--op-ink); font:inherit; font-size:.84rem }
.op-tl-bar input { flex:1 1 160px; min-width:0 }
.op-tl-count { flex-basis:100%; color:var(--op-ink); font-weight:600 }
.op-tl-wrap { overflow:auto; max-height:560px; border:1px solid var(--op-line); border-radius:10px }
.op-tl { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:.86rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums }
.op-tl th { position:sticky; top:0; z-index:1; background:var(--op-surface); text-align:left; font-weight:600; color:var(--op-muted); font-size:.78rem; padding:7px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--op-line) }
.op-tl td { padding:7px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--op-line); vertical-align:top }
.op-tl td small, .op-tl td .small { display:block; color:var(--op-muted); font-size:.76rem; line-height:1.35 }
.op-tl tr[hidden] { display:none }
.op-tl .op-badge { white-space:nowrap }
.op-a-assessed { background:var(--op-k2-bg) !important; color:var(--op-teal) }
.op-a-measured { background:var(--op-k3-bg) !important; color:var(--op-k3-ink) }
.op-a-none { background:var(--op-chip); color:var(--op-muted) }
.op-tl .op-new { margin-left:6px; background:var(--op-callout); color:var(--op-teal); font-size:.7rem }
.op-tl .op-bench-line { display:block; margin-top:3px; font-size:.8rem; line-height:1.35 }
.op-tl .op-bench-line b { font-weight:600 }
button.op-tl-go { border:0; background:none; padding:0; color:var(--op-teal); font:inherit; font-size:.76rem; text-decoration:underline; cursor:pointer }

/* Workloads */
.op-wl-pick { margin:10px 0 6px; font-size:.84rem; color:var(--op-muted) }
.op-wl-pick label { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:4px 6px; max-width:100% }
.op-wl-pick select { max-width:100%; min-width:0; padding:5px 8px; border:1px solid var(--op-line); border-radius:8px; background:var(--op-surface); color:var(--op-ink); font:inherit; font-size:.86rem }
.op-acc td small, .op-acc td .small { display:block; color:var(--op-muted); font-size:.76rem }

/* Selected product */
.op-pick { margin-top:12px; border:1px solid var(--op-line); border-radius:12px; padding:12px 14px }
.op-pick-head { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:8px 14px }
.op-pick-name { font-size:clamp(1.05rem,2vw,1.25rem); font-weight:700 }
.op-badge { display:inline-block; padding:.15em .65em; border-radius:999px; background:var(--op-chip); font-size:.8rem; font-weight:600 }
.op-pick-head label { margin-left:auto; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:.82rem; color:var(--op-muted) }
.op-pick select { max-width:min(260px,100%); min-width:0; padding:5px 8px; border:1px solid var(--op-line); border-radius:8px; background:var(--op-surface); color:var(--op-ink); font:inherit; font-size:.86rem }
.op-pick-body { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.5fr) minmax(0,1fr); gap:12px 22px; margin-top:10px }
.op-preds { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:.88rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums }
.op-preds th { text-align:left; font-weight:600; color:var(--op-muted); font-size:.78rem; padding:4px 6px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--op-line) }
.op-preds td { padding:5px 6px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--op-line) }
.op-preds tr:last-child td { border-bottom:0 }
.op-preds td.op-pos { color:var(--op-teal); font-weight:700 }
.op-preds td.op-negv { color:var(--op-neg); font-weight:700 }
.op-preds td.op-err { color:var(--op-muted) }
.op-preds tr.op-measured td { font-weight:700 }
.op-facts { font-size:.85rem; line-height:1.5 }
.op-facts div { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--op-line); padding:2px 0 }
.op-facts span { color:var(--op-muted) }
.op-facts b { font-weight:600; text-align:right }
.op-flag { margin-top:6px; color:var(--op-warn); font-size:.82rem; font-weight:600 }
.op-trust { margin-top:8px; padding:8px 10px; border-radius:8px; background:var(--op-chip); font-size:.82rem; line-height:1.45 }
.op-trust b { font-weight:700 }
.op-pick-foot { margin-top:8px; font-size:.8rem; color:var(--op-muted) }

/* Two charts side by side */
.op-pair { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:16px }
.op-keys { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px 16px; padding-top:10px; border-top:1px solid var(--op-line); font-size:.8rem }
.op-keys span { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px }
.op-shape { width:11px; height:11px; border:1.6px solid var(--op-ink); flex:none }
.op-shape.circle { border-radius:50% }
.op-shape.diamond { transform:rotate(45deg) scale(.85) }
.op-alt[hidden] { display:none !important }

/* Model accuracy */
.op-acc { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:.88rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; margin-top:8px }
.op-acc th { text-align:left; font-weight:600; color:var(--op-muted); font-size:.78rem; padding:6px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--op-line) }
.op-acc td { padding:6px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--op-line) }
.op-bar { display:inline-block; height:8px; border-radius:4px; background:var(--op-teal); vertical-align:middle; margin-right:8px; opacity:.75 }
.op-acc tr.op-base .op-bar { background:var(--op-muted) }

/* Evidence */
.op-evidence h2 { margin:24px 2px 10px; padding:0; border:0; font-size:clamp(1.15rem,2.2vw,1.45rem); font-weight:700; color:var(--op-ink) }
details.op-detail { border:1px solid var(--op-line); border-radius:10px; background:var(--op-surface); margin:10px 0; overflow-x:auto }
.op-detail summary { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,300px) minmax(0,1fr) 20px; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding:12px 20px; cursor:pointer; list-style:none; color:var(--op-ink) }
.op-detail summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none }
.op-detail summary b { font-size:1rem }
.op-detail summary span { padding-left:16px; border-left:1px solid var(--op-line); color:var(--op-muted); font-size:.88rem }
.op-detail summary .op-chev { width:20px; height:20px; transition:transform .15s }
.op-detail[open] summary .op-chev { transform:rotate(180deg) }
.op-detail-body { padding:4px 20px 18px }
.op-detail-body p { margin-bottom:.8rem !important; line-height:1.55 }
.op-detail-body h3 { font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; margin:1rem 0 .5rem; border:0 }
.op-closing { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:space-between; gap:6px 20px; margin-top:22px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px solid var(--op-line); color:var(--op-muted); font-size:.82rem }

/* CPU / GPU switch and benchmark selector: one view shows at a time. */
body:not(.op-gpu) main.content [data-kind="gpu"]:not(button), body.op-gpu main.content [data-kind="cpu"]:not(button),
body:not(.op-spec) main.content [data-bench="spec"]:not(button), body.op-spec main.content [data-bench="blender"]:not(button) { display:none !important }

/* Quarto wraps cell output in column grids; keep these blocks as plain boxes. */
main.content .op-view { grid-column:page-start / page-end !important }
main.content .op-view, main.content .op-view .page-columns { display:block !important }
main.content .op-view .op-pair { display:grid !important; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)) !important }
main.content .op-view .op-main-grid { display:grid !important; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 250px !important }
main.content .op-view .page-columns > * { grid-column:auto !important; min-width:0 }

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .op-kpis { grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr) }
  main.content .op-view .op-pair, main.content .op-view .op-main-grid { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) !important }
  .op-legend { border-left:0; border-top:1px solid var(--op-line); padding:14px 0 0 }
  .op-legend ul { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:0 14px }
  .op-detail summary { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 20px }
  .op-detail summary span { display:none }
  .op-pick-body { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) }
}
@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .op-tl th:nth-child(5), .op-tl td:nth-child(5), .op-tl th:nth-child(6), .op-tl td:nth-child(6) { display:none }
  .op-pick-head label { margin-left:0; flex-wrap:wrap; max-width:100% }
  .op-preds { font-size:.8rem }
  .op-preds th, .op-preds td { padding:4px 3px }
}
</style>

```{python}
import json
import sys
from html import escape

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import Markdown, display
from itables import init_notebook_mode, show

from pdi import site
from pdi.tech_value import catalogue as tvcat

# Bundle the table script into the page instead of loading it from a CDN.
init_notebook_mode(connected=False)

cpu, cpu_meta = site.load("tech-value", "residuals")
gpu, gpu_meta = site.load("tech-value", "gpu_residuals")
cpu_val, cpu_val_meta = site.load("tech-value", "residual_validation")
gpu_val, gpu_val_meta = site.load("tech-value", "gpu_residual_validation")
cat, cat_meta = site.load("tech-value", "catalogue")
bl, bl_meta = site.load("tech-value", "blender_residuals")
bl_val, bl_val_meta = site.load("tech-value", "blender_residual_validation")
bl_chk, bl_chk_meta = site.load("tech-value", "blender_version_check")
gpu_wl, gpu_wl_meta = site.load("tech-value", "gpu_workloads")
gpu_cal, gpu_cal_meta = site.load("tech-value", "gpu_calibration")
HIST, HIST_META = site.load("tech-value", "coverage_history")

KINDS = ("cpu", "gpu")
BENCHES = ("blender", "spec")
BENCH = {"blender": "Blender rendering", "spec": "SPEC workloads"}
NOUN = {"cpu": "CPUs", "gpu": "GPUs"}
ONE = {"cpu": "processor", "gpu": "graphics card"}
MODELS = {"ols": "OLS", "structural": "Structural L1", "nonlinear": "Nonlinear GBDT"}
VAL_NAME = {"ols": "OLS", "structural": "Structural L1", "nonlinear": "Nonlinear GBDT"}
SPEC_SUITE = {"cpu": "SPEC CPU 2017", "gpu": "SPEC GWPG"}
MEASURE = {
    ("cpu", "spec"): "SPECrate 2017 Int base per socket",
    ("gpu", "spec"): "Calibrated SPEC GWPG score (site estimate)",
    ("cpu", "blender"): "Blender score (samples per minute)",
    ("gpu", "blender"): "Blender score (samples per minute)",
}
BL_VERSION = bl_meta.get("blender_version") or bl_val_meta.get("blender_version")
BL_FEW_RUNS = 10

# The pipeline's classifications, grouped into the four classes this page shows.
CLASS_OF = {
    "Above prediction across models": "above",
    "Below prediction across models": "below",
    "Model-sensitive (small-core)": "sensitive",
    "Model-sensitive (scaling regime)": "sensitive",
    "Model-sensitive (entry-level shaders)": "sensitive",
}
CLASSES = {
    "above": ("Above prediction across models", "Measured score above all three predictions.", "#18b47b"),
    "sensitive": ("Model-sensitive", "Above the straight-line model, much less so once scaling is allowed to bend.", "#f0b23e"),
    "near": ("Near prediction", "Within the models' usual error.", "#c4cad1"),
    "below": ("Below prediction across models", "A candidate for checking scaling, configuration or model limits.", "#d9707a"),
}
FONT = dict(family="Century Gothic, URW Gothic, Questrial, system-ui, sans-serif", color="#8391a1", size=12)
AXIS = dict(showgrid=False, showline=True, linecolor="#8391a1", ticks="outside", zeroline=False)
HOVER = dict(bgcolor="white", font_color="#14233a", font_family=FONT["family"])

SRC_DATES = {src.get("id"): src.get("retrieved_at") for src in cat_meta.get("sources") or []}
PRICE = {} if cat.empty else {
    (r.kind, r.model_key): (float(r.price_usd), r.price_date)
    for r in cat.itertuples() if pd.notna(r.price_usd)
}


def day(ts):
    return str(ts)[:10] if ts else "not recorded"


def collected(meta):
    srcs = meta.get("sources") or []
    return day(srcs[0].get("retrieved_at")) if srcs else "not recorded"


def tracked(kind):
    """Products on Value ranking or Fair price: the retail-tracked list, refreshed every update."""
    if cat.empty or "tracked" not in cat.columns:
        return cat.iloc[0:0]
    return cat[(cat["kind"] == kind) & cat["tracked"].astype(bool)]


TRACKED_KEYS = {k: set(tracked(k)["model_key"]) for k in KINDS}


def spec_frame(kind):
    df = (cpu if kind == "cpu" else gpu).copy()
    if df.empty:
        return df
    df["cls"] = df["consensus_verdict"].map(CLASS_OF).fillna("near")
    df["y"] = df["measured_per_socket" if kind == "cpu" else "measured_score"]
    df["key"] = [tvcat.key_of(kind, p) for p in df["processor"]]
    df["tracked"] = df["key"].isin(TRACKED_KEYS[kind])
    df["cores"] = df["cores_per_chip"]
    df["gen"] = pd.to_numeric(df["generation"], errors="coerce")
    df["form"] = df["form_factor"] if "form_factor" in df else ""
    df["unit_score"] = df["score_per_core"]
    df["tier_x"] = df["l3_mb_per_core"] if kind == "cpu" else df["bandwidth_gbps"]
    oems = df["n_oems"].astype(int)
    df["evidence"] = [f"{int(n)} SPEC disclosure{'s' if n != 1 else ''} · {o} OEM{'s' if o != 1 else ''}"
                      for n, o in zip(df["n_results"], oems)]
    df["limited"] = (oems <= 1) | (df["n_results"].astype(int) < 4)
    return df.reset_index(drop=True)


def blender_frame(kind):
    if bl.empty:
        return bl
    df = bl[bl["kind"] == kind].copy().reset_index(drop=True)
    if df.empty:
        return df
    df["cls"] = df["consensus_verdict"].map(CLASS_OF).fillna("near")
    df["y"] = df["measured_score"]
    df["key"] = df["model_key"]
    df["tracked"] = df["key"].isin(TRACKED_KEYS[kind])
    df["gen"] = pd.to_numeric(df["release_year"], errors="coerce")
    df["form"] = df["form_factor"] if kind == "gpu" else ""
    df["unit_score"] = df["y"] / df["cores"] if kind == "cpu" else 1000 * df["y"] / df["cores"]
    df["tier_x"] = df["l3_mb"] / df["cores"] if kind == "cpu" else df["bandwidth_gbps"]
    df["evidence"] = [f"{int(n):,} Blender run{'s' if n != 1 else ''}" + (f" · {b}" if kind == "gpu" else "")
                      for n, b in zip(df["n_runs"], df["backend"])]
    df["limited"] = df["n_runs"].astype(int) < BL_FEW_RUNS
    return df


def val_frame(kind, bench):
    if bench == "spec":
        return cpu_val if kind == "cpu" else gpu_val
    return bl_val[bl_val["kind"] == kind] if not bl_val.empty else bl_val


VIEWS = {}
for _k in KINDS:
    VIEWS[(_k, "spec")] = dict(kind=_k, bench="spec", df=spec_frame(_k), meta=cpu_meta if _k == "cpu" else gpu_meta,
                               val=val_frame(_k, "spec"))
    VIEWS[(_k, "blender")] = dict(kind=_k, bench="blender", df=blender_frame(_k), meta=bl_meta,
                                  val=val_frame(_k, "blender"))


def typical_error(v):
    """Median absolute held-out error per model and the share inside the 80% range, over all ranked products."""
    val = v["val"]
    if val.empty:
        return {}
    a = val[val["slice"] == "All"].set_index("model")
    return {m: (float(r["median_abs_pct_error"]),
                None if pd.isna(r["range_coverage_pct"]) else float(r["range_coverage_pct"]))
            for m, r in a.iterrows()}


def err_line(v):
    err = typical_error(v)
    parts = [f"{VAL_NAME[m]} {err[VAL_NAME[m]][0]:.1f}%" for m in MODELS if VAL_NAME[m] in err]
    base = next((e for m, e in err.items() if m.startswith("Baseline")), None)
    txt = " · ".join(parts)
    if base:
        txt += f" (simple baseline {base[0]:.1f}%)"
    return txt


def coverage_pct(v):
    err = typical_error(v)
    covs = [err[VAL_NAME[m]][1] for m in MODELS if VAL_NAME[m] in err and err[VAL_NAME[m]][1] is not None]
    return (min(covs), max(covs)) if covs else None


def version_text(kind):
    """How far Blender residuals moved when the same fit ran on other Blender versions."""
    c = bl_chk[bl_chk["kind"] == kind] if not bl_chk.empty else bl_chk
    if c.empty:
        return ""
    parts = [f"{r.median_abs_gap_pct:.1f}% on Blender {r.check_version} ({int(r.n_shared)} shared)"
             for r in c.itertuples() if pd.notna(r.median_abs_gap_pct)]
    return "Refitted on other Blender versions, the median residual moved " + " and ".join(parts) + \
        ". That is an average: a single product can move further."


ICON = {
    "chev": '<path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/>',
    "warn": '<path d="M12 3l10 18H2z"/><path d="M12 10v5M12 18v.5"/>',
}


def icon(name, cls=""):
    return f'<svg class="op-ico {cls}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">{ICON[name]}</svg>'


def raw(html):
    """Emit HTML as a raw block so pandoc does not re-parse it as markdown."""
    print(f"\n```{{=html}}\n{html}\n```\n", flush=True)


def plot(fig):
    sys.stdout.flush()
    fig.show(config={"displayModeBar": False, "responsive": True})
    sys.stdout.flush()


def head(title, *ledes):
    raw(f"<h2>{title}</h2>" + "".join(f'<p class="op-lede">{t}</p>' for t in ledes))


def _fmt(v, digits=1):
    if v is None or pd.isna(v):
        return ""
    return f"{v:,.{digits}f}" if abs(v) < 100 else f"{v:,.0f}"


def signed(v):
    return "" if v is None or pd.isna(v) else f"{v:+.1f}%"
```

```{python}
def bench_counts(kind):
    t = tracked(kind)
    if t.empty:
        return 0, 0, 0, 0
    spec_on = t["on_residuals"].astype(bool)
    bl_on = t["on_blender_residuals"].astype(bool) if "on_blender_residuals" in t else spec_on & False
    return len(t), int(bl_on.sum()), int(spec_on.sum()), int((spec_on | bl_on).sum())


def bench_button(bench):
    subs = ""
    for kind in KINDS:
        n, b, s, _ = bench_counts(kind)
        k = b if bench == "blender" else s
        what = "rendering only" if bench == "blender" else "varied workloads"
        subs += f'<small data-kind="{kind}">{what} · {k} of {n} tracked {NOUN[kind]}</small>'
    return (f'<button type="button" data-bench="{bench}" aria-pressed="{str(bench == "blender").lower()}">'
            f'<span>{BENCH[bench]}</span>{subs}</button>')


meta_line = {

}

</nav>
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
def headline(kind):
    """Coverage of the tracked list, by benchmark, counting overlaps once."""
    t = tracked(kind)
    if t.empty:
        return ""
    n, by_bl, by_spec, either = bench_counts(kind)
    both = by_bl + by_spec - either
    m = int((t["assessment"] == tvcat.MEASURED_ONLY).sum())
    none = int((t["assessment"] == tvcat.NO_MEASUREMENT).sum())
    trend = ""
    if not HIST.empty:
        h = HIST[HIST["kind"] == kind].sort_values("date")
        if len(h):
            cutoff = (pd.Timestamp(str(h["date"].iloc[-1])) - pd.Timedelta(days=7)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
            before = h[h["date"] <= cutoff]
            if len(before):
                b = before.iloc[-1]
                trend = f" A week earlier ({b['date']}): {int(b['assessed'])}/{int(b['tracked'])}."
            else:
                trend = f" Coverage is recorded at every update from {h['date'].iloc[0]} on."
    rest = []
    if m:
        rest.append(f"{m} more {'has' if m == 1 else 'have'} a measurement no model can assess yet")
    if none:
        rest.append(f"{none} {'has' if none == 1 else 'have'} none")
    rest_txt = (" " + " and ".join(rest) + ".") if rest else ""
    return (f'<div class="op-head" data-kind="{kind}"><strong>{either}/{n}</strong>'
            f'<span class="op-head-label">tracked {NOUN[kind]} assessed by at least one benchmark</span>'
            f'<span class="op-head-sub">Blender rendering assesses {by_bl}, SPEC workloads {by_spec}, both {both}. '
            f'Tracked means on Value ranking or Fair price today.{rest_txt}{trend} '
            f'Blender measures rendering only, so for many products there is no evidence yet on other workloads.</span></div>')


def count(v, cls):
    df = v["df"]
    return int((df["cls"] == cls).sum()) if not df.empty else 0


def kpis(v):
    df = v["df"]
    if df.empty:
        return ""
    n_t = int(df["tracked"].sum())
    noun = NOUN[v["kind"]]
    first = (f'<div class="op-kpi"><strong>{len(df):,}</strong><span>{noun} ranked on {BENCH[v["bench"]]}</span>'
             f'<small>{n_t} of them tracked retail products</small></div>')
    body = "".join(f'<div class="op-kpi"><strong>{count(v, c):,}</strong><span>{label}</span><small>of the {len(df):,} ranked</small></div>'
                   for c, label in (("above", "Above prediction across models"), ("sensitive", "Model-sensitive"),
                                    ("below", "Below prediction across models")))
    err = err_line(v)
    note = (f'<p class="op-note">Typical held-out error on {BENCH[v["bench"]]} for {noun}: {err}. '
            "A verdict means the three models agree on the direction; it is not a confidence level, "
            "and a residual smaller than the typical error says little on its own.</p>")
    return f'<div class="op-kpis">{first}{body}</div>{note}'


def find_bar(kind):
    names = sorted(cat.loc[cat["kind"] == kind, "name"].dropna().unique()) if not cat.empty else []
    opts = "".join(f'<option value="{escape(n)}">' for n in names)
    return (f'<div class="op-find" data-kind="{kind}"><label>Find a {ONE[kind]}'
            f'<input type="search" list="op-find-{kind}" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Type a name, e.g. {"7950X" if kind == "cpu" else "4060"}" '
            f'aria-label="Find a {ONE[kind]}"></label><datalist id="op-find-{kind}">{opts}</datalist>'
            f'<span class="op-find-msg" aria-live="polite"></span></div>'
            f'<div class="tv-pick-panel" data-kind="{kind}" hidden></div>')


html = ""
for kind in KINDS:
    html += headline(kind)
    html += find_bar(kind)
    for bench in BENCHES:
        html += f'<div data-kind="{kind}" data-bench="{bench}">{kpis(VIEWS[(kind, bench)])}</div>'
raw(html)
```

```{python}
def log_ticks(lo, hi):
    vals = [m * 10 ** e for e in range(-2, 7) for m in (1, 2, 5)]
    return [v for v in vals if lo / 1.15 <= v <= hi * 1.15]


def main_chart(v):
    """Measured against predicted, one set of points per model; the buttons switch models."""
    df = v["df"]
    y = df["y"]
    preds = [df[f"pred_{m}"] for m in MODELS]
    lo = float(min(y.min(), *(p.min() for p in preds)))
    hi = float(max(y.max(), *(p.max() for p in preds)))
    fig = go.Figure()
    fig.add_scatter(x=[lo / 1.2, hi * 1.2], y=[lo / 1.2, hi * 1.2], mode="lines", hoverinfo="skip",
                    line=dict(color="#55606c", width=1.3), showlegend=False, name="equal")
    tracked_txt = np.where(df["tracked"], "<br>Tracked retail product", "")
    for key, label in MODELS.items():
        for cls in ("near", "sensitive", "below", "above"):
            part = df[df["cls"] == cls]
            if part.empty:
                continue
            custom = np.stack([
                part["processor"], [CLASSES[cls][0]] * len(part),
                np.expm1(part[f"{key}_resid_log"]) * 100,
                part[f"pred_{key}_lo"], part[f"pred_{key}_hi"], part["evidence"], tracked_txt[part.index],
            ], axis=-1)
            fig.add_scatter(
                x=part[f"pred_{key}"].tolist(), y=part["y"].tolist(), mode="markers", name=f"m:{key}:{cls}", visible=(key == "ols"),
                marker=dict(size=6 if cls == "near" else 8, color=CLASSES[cls][2],
                            opacity=0.7 if cls == "near" else 0.95, line=dict(width=0.6, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.8)")),
                customdata=custom.tolist(), showlegend=False,
                hovertemplate=(f"<b>%{{customdata[0]}}</b><br>%{{customdata[1]}}<br>Measured %{{y:,.1f}} · {label} %{{x:,.1f}}"
                               " (%{customdata[2]:+.1f}%)<br>80% range %{customdata[3]:,.1f} – %{customdata[4]:,.1f}"
                               "<br>%{customdata[5]}%{customdata[6]}<extra></extra>"),
            )
    fig.add_scatter(x=[None], y=[None], mode="markers", name="selected", hoverinfo="skip", showlegend=False,
                    marker=dict(size=17, color="rgba(24,180,123,0.2)", line=dict(width=2.4, color="#0f8f6c")))
    ticks = log_ticks(lo, hi)
    rng = [np.log10(lo / 1.15), np.log10(hi * 1.15)]
    fig.update_layout(
        height=460, font=FONT, margin=dict(t=10, r=10, b=54, l=74),
        paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        xaxis=dict(**AXIS, type="log", range=rng, tickvals=ticks, ticktext=[f"{t:,g}" for t in ticks],
                   title="Predicted by OLS (log scale)"),
        yaxis=dict(**AXIS, type="log", range=rng, tickvals=ticks, ticktext=[f"{t:,g}" for t in ticks],
                   title=f"Measured: {MEASURE[(v['kind'], v['bench'])]}"),
        hoverlabel=HOVER, dragmode=False,
        annotations=[dict(x=0.98, y=0.04, xref="paper", yref="paper", showarrow=False, xanchor="right",
                          text="Line = measured equals predicted", font=dict(size=11, color="#8391a1"))],
    )
    plot(fig)


def legend_html():
    items = "".join(
        f'<li><span class="op-dot" style="background:{c}"></span><span><b>{n}</b><small>{d}</small></span></li>'
        for n, d, c in CLASSES.values()
    )
    return (f'<aside class="op-legend"><ul>{items}</ul><hr><small>Classes use all three models. '
            'The chart shows one model at a time.</small>'
            '<div class="op-callout">Above the line = measured score higher than predicted.</div></aside>')


def model_buttons(v):
    err = typical_error(v)
    btns = "".join(
        f'<button type="button" data-model="{k}" aria-pressed="{str(k == "ols").lower()}">{lbl}'
        + (f' <small>· {err[lbl][0]:.1f}% typical error</small>' if lbl in err else "") + "</button>"
        for k, lbl in MODELS.items()
    )
    raw(f'<div class="tv-seg" role="group" aria-label="Prediction model">{btns}</div>')


def chip_rows(v):
    df, kind, bench = v["df"], v["kind"], v["bench"]
    rows = []
    for _, r in df.iterrows():
        preds = {}
        for key in MODELS:
            preds[key] = dict(p=round(float(r[f"pred_{key}"]), 2),
                              lo=None if pd.isna(r[f"pred_{key}_lo"]) else round(float(r[f"pred_{key}_lo"]), 2),
                              hi=None if pd.isna(r[f"pred_{key}_hi"]) else round(float(r[f"pred_{key}_hi"]), 2),
                              r=round(float(np.expm1(r[f"{key}_resid_log"]) * 100), 1))
        price, price_date = PRICE.get((kind, r["key"]), (None, None))
        if bench == "spec":
            facts = [("SPEC disclosures", int(r["n_results"])), ("OEMs", int(r["n_oems"])),
                     ("Distinct systems", int(r["n_systems"])), ("Distinct configurations", int(r["n_configs"]))]
            if kind == "cpu":
                facts += [("Sockets tested", r["sockets_tested"]),
                          ("Test dates", f'{day(r["first_test_date"])} to {day(r["last_test_date"])}'),
                          ("Config spread", f'{r["tuning_spread_pct"]:.1f} pts')]
                if pd.notna(r.get("peak_gain_pct")):
                    facts.append(("Peak vs base compiler gain", f'{r["peak_gain_pct"]:+.1f}%'))
            else:
                facts += [("Suites", r["suites_tested"]), ("Released", int(r["generation"])),
                          ("Config spread", f'{r["tuning_spread_pct"]:.1f} pts'),
                          ("Workload specialization", f'{r["workload_specialization_pct"]:+.0f}%')]
            if price:
                facts.append(("Retail price", f"${price:,.0f} ({price_date})"))
                facts.append(("SPEC score per $100", f"{100 * float(r['y']) / price:,.1f}"))
            limited_txt = "Limited evidence: fewer than four SPEC disclosures or one OEM"
            url = r.get("disclosure_url") or ""
        else:
            facts = [("Blender runs", f'{int(r["n_runs"]):,}'),
                     ("Middle half of runs", f'{r["p25_score"]:,.0f} – {r["p75_score"]:,.0f}')]
            if kind == "cpu":
                cores = f'{int(r["cores"])}' + (f' ({int(r["p_cores"])}P + {int(r["e_cores"])}E)' if r["e_cores"] else "")
                facts += [("Cores", cores), ("Threads", int(r["threads"])),
                          ("Boost clock", f'{r["boost_mhz"]:,.0f} MHz'), ("L3 cache", f'{r["l3_mb"]:,.0f} MB'),
                          ("TDP", f'{r["tdp_w"]:,.0f} W')]
            else:
                facts += [("Backend", r["backend"]), ("Shaders", f'{int(r["cores"]):,}'),
                          ("Boost clock", f'{r["mhz"]:,.0f} MHz'), ("VRAM", f'{r["vram_gb"]:g} GB'),
                          ("Memory bandwidth", f'{r["bandwidth_gbps"]:,.0f} GB/s')]
            facts.append(("Released", int(r["release_year"])))
            if price:
                facts.append(("Retail price", f"${price:,.0f} ({price_date})"))
                facts.append(("Blender points per dollar", f"{float(r['y']) / price:,.2f}"))
            limited_txt = f"Limited evidence: fewer than {BL_FEW_RUNS} Blender runs"
            url = ""
        rows.append(dict(
            key=r["key"], vendor=r["vendor"], group=r["family"], form=r["form"] if isinstance(r["form"], str) else "",
            gen=None if pd.isna(r["gen"]) else int(r["gen"]), cores=float(r["cores"]), price=price,
            tracked=bool(r["tracked"]), name=r["processor"], cls=CLASSES[r["cls"]][0], verdict=r["consensus_verdict"],
            y=round(float(r["y"]), 2), preds=preds, spread=round(float(r["model_spread_pts"]), 1),
            oor=r["outside_training_range"] if isinstance(r["outside_training_range"], str) else "",
            limited=limited_txt if bool(r["limited"]) else "", facts=facts, url=url,
        ))
    return rows


def default_pick(v):
    df = v["df"]
    pool = df[df["tracked"]] if df["tracked"].any() else df
    if v["kind"] == "gpu" and v["bench"] == "blender" and (pool["key"] == "nvidia rtx 4060").any():
        return "nvidia rtx 4060"
    above = pool[pool["cls"] == "above"]
    return (above if len(above) else pool).sort_values("nonlinear_resid_log").iloc[-1]["key"]


def pick(v):
    kind, bench = v["kind"], v["bench"]
    rows = chip_rows(v)
    default = default_pick(v)
    opts = "".join(f'<option value="{escape(d["key"])}"{" selected" if d["key"] == default else ""}>{escape(d["name"])}</option>'
                   for d in sorted(rows, key=lambda d: (not d["tracked"], d["name"])))
    err = typical_error(v)
    errs = {k: err[VAL_NAME[k]][0] for k in MODELS if VAL_NAME[k] in err}
    cov = coverage_pct(v)
    cov_txt = f"{cov[0]:.0f}%" if cov and cov[0] == cov[1] else (f"{cov[0]:.0f}–{cov[1]:.0f}%" if cov else "about 80%")
    stab = version_text(kind) if bench == "blender" else ""
    trust = (f'<div class="op-trust"><b>How far to trust this.</b> The verdict says whether all three models put this {ONE[kind]} '
             f'on the same side of its prediction. Agreement is not statistical confidence: compare the residual with the '
             f'typical held-out error beside it, and with the 80% range, which held {cov_txt} of {NOUN[kind]} in held-out checks. '
             f'{escape(stab)}</div>')
    src = ("Predicted scores are this site's estimates, not SPEC metrics." if bench == "spec" else
           "Predicted scores are this site's estimates from Blender Open Data (CC0); the Blender Foundation does not endorse them.")
    raw(f"""<div class="op-pick" data-chips="{escape(json.dumps(rows), quote=True)}" data-errs="{escape(json.dumps(errs), quote=True)}">
<div class="op-pick-head"><span class="op-pick-name" data-f="name"></span><span class="op-badge" data-f="cls"></span>
<label>Inspect a {ONE[kind]}<select aria-label="Inspect a {ONE[kind]} on {BENCH[bench]}">{opts}</select></label></div>
<div class="op-pick-body">
<div><table class="op-preds"><thead><tr><th></th><th>Score</th><th>80% range</th><th>Residual</th><th>Typical error</th></tr></thead><tbody data-f="preds"></tbody></table>
<div class="op-flag" data-f="flags"></div>{trust}</div>
<div class="op-facts" data-f="facts"></div>
</div>
<div class="op-pick-foot">{src} Tracked retail products are listed first. <span data-f="link"></span></div>
</div>""")


def peers(v):
    """Filters that narrow the main chart to comparable products, with a count."""
    df, kind, bench = v["df"], v["kind"], v["bench"]

    def options(values, label):
        vals = sorted({str(x) for x in values if pd.notna(x) and str(x)})
        return f'<option value="">{label}: all</option>' + "".join(
            f'<option value="{escape(x)}">{escape(x)}</option>' for x in vals)

    years = sorted({int(x) for x in df["gen"].dropna()})
    yopts = lambda first: "".join(f'<option{" selected" if y == first else ""}>{y}</option>' for y in years)
    group_label = "Family" if kind == "cpu" else "Architecture"
    form = ("" if kind == "cpu" or not df["form"].astype(bool).any() else
            f'<select data-peer="form" aria-label="Form factor">{options(df["form"], "Form factor")}</select>')
    unit = "Cores" if kind == "cpu" else "Shaders"
    n_t = int(df["tracked"].sum())
    n_priced = sum(1 for k in df["key"] if (kind, k) in PRICE)
    scope = (f'<select data-peer="tracked" aria-label="Which products"><option value="t" selected>Tracked retail products ({n_t})</option>'
             f'<option value="">Every benchmarked {ONE[kind]} ({len(df)})</option></select>') if n_t else ""
    raw(f"""<div class="op-peers" role="group" aria-label="Comparable {NOUN[kind]}">{scope}
<select data-peer="vendor" aria-label="Vendor">{options(df["vendor"], "Vendor")}</select>
<select data-peer="group" aria-label="{group_label}">{options(df["family"], group_label)}</select>{form}
<span class="op-peer-range">Released <select data-peer="gen0" aria-label="Released from">{yopts(years[0])}</select>
to <select data-peer="gen1" aria-label="Released to">{yopts(years[-1])}</select></span>
<span class="op-peer-range">{unit} <input data-peer="c0" type="number" min="0" placeholder="min" aria-label="{unit} at least">
<input data-peer="c1" type="number" min="0" placeholder="max" aria-label="{unit} at most"></span>
<span class="op-peer-range" title="Retail price from the Value ranking; known for {n_priced} of {len(df)}">Price $ <input data-peer="p0" type="number" min="0" placeholder="min" aria-label="Price at least">
<input data-peer="p1" type="number" min="0" placeholder="max" aria-label="Price at most"></span>
<button type="button" data-peer="reset" class="op-peer-reset">Reset</button>
<span class="op-peer-count" aria-live="polite"></span>
</div>""")


def main_card(v):
    kind, bench = v["kind"], v["bench"]

    elif kind == "cpu":
        lede = ("Each point is a processor. Its SPEC score is plotted against the score a model predicts from its specifications, "
                "using a fit that never saw that processor. Pick a model, then hover or click a point.")
    else:
        lede = ("Each point is a graphics card. Its calibrated workstation score is plotted against the score a model predicts from its "
                "specifications, using a fit that never saw that card. Only suites whose calibration passes the check below are combined. "
                "Pick a model, then hover or click a point.")

    raw(f"</div>{legend_html()}</div>")
    pick(v)

CMP_DEFAULT = {"cpu": ("amd ryzen 9 7950x", "intel core i9-13900k"),
```

```{python}
def agreement(v):
    df = v["df"]
    o = np.expm1(df["ols_resid_log"]) * 100
    n = np.expm1(df["nonlinear_resid_log"]) * 100
    lim = max(60, float(np.ceil(max(o.abs().max(), n.abs().max()) / 20) * 20))
    fig = go.Figure()
    fig.add_shape(type="rect", x0=0, y0=0, x1=lim, y1=lim, fillcolor="rgba(24,180,123,0.08)", line_width=0, layer="below")
    fig.add_hline(y=0, line=dict(color="#55606c", width=1))
    fig.add_vline(x=0, line=dict(color="#55606c", width=1))
    for cls in ("near", "sensitive", "below", "above"):
        m = (df["cls"] == cls).to_numpy()
        if not m.any():
            continue
        fig.add_scatter(x=o[m], y=n[m], mode="markers", showlegend=False,
                        marker=dict(size=6, color=CLASSES[cls][2], opacity=0.85),
                        customdata=df["processor"][m], hovertemplate="<b>%{customdata}</b><br>OLS %{x:+.1f}% · Nonlinear %{y:+.1f}%<extra></extra>")
    step = 20 if lim <= 100 else 40
    vals = list(range(-int(lim), int(lim) + 1, step))
    text = [f"{x:+d}%" if x else "0%" for x in vals]
    fig.update_layout(height=320, font=FONT, margin=dict(t=6, r=8, b=50, l=62),
                      paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
                      xaxis=dict(**AXIS, range=[-lim, lim], tickvals=vals, ticktext=text, title="Residual vs OLS (%)"),
                      yaxis=dict(**AXIS, range=[-lim, lim], tickvals=vals, ticktext=text, title="Residual vs nonlinear (%)"),
                      hoverlabel=HOVER, dragmode=False)
    plot(fig)


SHORT_GROUP = {
    "Intel oneAPI (LLVM)": "Intel oneAPI",
    "Oracle / Vendor Studio": "Oracle Studio",
    "SPECviewperf 15 (DX12 / Vulkan / OpenGL)": "SPECviewperf 15",
    "SPECviewperf 2020 (OpenGL / DX12)": "SPECviewperf 2020",
    "SPECviewperf 12.1 / 13 (Legacy OpenGL)": "SPECviewperf 12.1 / 13",
    "SPECworkstation (Full System + GPU)": "SPECworkstation",
    "SPECapc (Maya / Solidworks / Creo / 3ds Max)": "SPECapc",
}


def group_table(df):
    g = df.groupby("compiler_family").agg(
        chips=("processor", "size"), disclosures=("n_results", "sum"),
        spread=("tuning_spread_pct", "median"), configs=("n_configs", "median"),
        ols=("residual_pct", "median"), nonlinear=("gbdt_residual_pct", "median"),
    ).reset_index()
    return g.sort_values("disclosures", ascending=False)


def spread_chart(v):
    g = group_table(v["df"]).sort_values("disclosures")
    labels = [f"{SHORT_GROUP.get(f, f)} ({c})" for f, c in zip(g["compiler_family"], g["chips"])]
    fig = go.Figure()
    for y, x in zip(labels, g["spread"]):
        fig.add_shape(type="line", x0=0, x1=x, y0=y, y1=y, line=dict(color="#8391a1", width=1.5))
    fig.add_scatter(
        x=g["spread"], y=labels, mode="markers+text", text=[f"{x:.1f}" for x in g["spread"]],
        textposition="middle right", textfont=dict(color="#8391a1", size=12),
        marker=dict(size=12, color="#18b47b", line=dict(width=1, color="white")),
        customdata=np.stack([g["chips"], g["disclosures"], g["configs"]], axis=-1),
        hovertemplate="%{y}<br>Median spread %{x:.1f} pts<br>%{customdata[0]} chips · %{customdata[1]} disclosures"
                      "<br>Median %{customdata[2]} configurations per chip<extra></extra>",
        showlegend=False,
    )
    hi = float(np.ceil((g["spread"].max() * 1.25) / 5) * 5)
    fig.update_layout(
        height=max(240, 60 + 46 * len(g)), font=FONT, margin=dict(t=6, r=12, b=50, l=10),
        paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        xaxis=dict(**AXIS, range=[0, hi], title="Median spread across submitted configurations (pts)"),
        yaxis=dict(showgrid=False, showline=False, ticks="", automargin=True),
        hoverlabel=HOVER, dragmode=False,
    )
    plot(fig)


TIERS = {
    "cpu": ([1.5, 3.0], ["Low L3", "Standard L3", "High L3"], "MB L3 per core"),
    "gpu": ([200, 500], ["Low bandwidth", "Standard bandwidth", "High bandwidth"], "GB/s"),
}
TIER_COLORS = ["#d9707a", "#f0b23e", "#18b47b"]
SYMBOLS = {"cpu": {"Intel": "circle", "AMD": "diamond"}, "gpu": {"NVIDIA": "circle", "AMD": "diamond"}}


def symbol_of(kind, vendor):
    return SYMBOLS[kind].get(vendor, "square")


def scaling_chart(v, metric):
    """metric 'unit': throughput per core or per 1,000 shaders; 'total': measured score."""
    kind, bench = v["kind"], v["bench"]
    df = v["df"].dropna(subset=["cores"]).copy()
    cuts, names, unit = TIERS[kind]
    df["tier"] = np.digitize(df["tier_x"].fillna(df["tier_x"].median()), cuts)
    if metric == "unit":
        df["yv"] = df["unit_score"]
        what = "Blender score" if bench == "blender" else ("Base score" if kind == "cpu" else "Score")
        ytitle = f"{what} per core" if kind == "cpu" else f"{what} per 1,000 shaders"
    else:
        df["yv"] = df["y"]
        ytitle = ("Blender score" if bench == "blender" else
                  ("Base score per socket" if kind == "cpu" else "Calibrated score"))
    fig = go.Figure()
    for t in range(len(names)):
        for vendor in sorted(df["vendor"].dropna().unique()):
            part = df[(df["tier"] == t) & (df["vendor"] == vendor)]
            if part.empty:
                continue
            fig.add_scatter(
                x=part["cores"], y=part["yv"], mode="markers", showlegend=False,
                marker=dict(size=7, symbol=symbol_of(kind, vendor), color=TIER_COLORS[t], opacity=0.85,
                            line=dict(width=0.6, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.8)")),
                customdata=np.stack([part["processor"], part["tier_x"], part["residual_pct"]], axis=-1),
                hovertemplate=f"<b>%{{customdata[0]}}</b><br>%{{x:,.0f}} {'cores' if kind == 'cpu' else 'shaders'} · "
                              f"%{{y:,.1f}}<br>%{{customdata[1]:.1f}} {unit} · OLS residual %{{customdata[2]:+.1f}}%<extra></extra>",
            )
    lo, hi = df["cores"].min(), df["cores"].max()
    xt = [2 ** e for e in range(0, 16) if lo / 1.5 <= 2 ** e <= hi * 1.5]
    if kind == "gpu":
        xt = [x for x in (500, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000, 20000) if lo / 1.5 <= x <= hi * 1.5]
    yt = log_ticks(df["yv"].min(), df["yv"].max())
    fig.update_layout(
        height=320, font=FONT, margin=dict(t=6, r=10, b=50, l=64),
        paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        xaxis=dict(**AXIS, type="log", tickvals=xt, ticktext=[f"{x:,}" for x in xt],
                   title="Cores per chip (log scale)" if kind == "cpu" else "Shaders (log scale)"),
        yaxis=dict(**AXIS, type="log", tickvals=yt, ticktext=[f"{x:,g}" for x in yt], title=ytitle),
        hoverlabel=HOVER, dragmode=False,
    )
    plot(fig)


def scaling_card(v):
    kind = v["kind"]
    raw('<div class="op-card">')
    what = "core" if kind == "cpu" else "shader"
    by = "L3 cache per core" if kind == "cpu" else "memory bandwidth"
    head("Where does scaling slow down?",
         f"Throughput as {what} count rises, colored by {by}, shaped by vendor. These are associations to investigate, not causes.")
    unit_lbl = "Per core" if kind == "cpu" else "Per 1,000 shaders"
    total = ("Per socket" if kind == "cpu" else "Total") if v["bench"] == "spec" else "Total"
    raw(f'<div class="tv-seg" role="group" aria-label="Throughput measure"><button type="button" data-alt="unit" aria-pressed="true">{unit_lbl}</button>'
        f'<button type="button" data-alt="total" aria-pressed="false">{total}</button></div>')
    raw('<div class="op-alt" data-alt="unit">')
    scaling_chart(v, "unit")
    raw('</div><div class="op-alt" data-alt="total" hidden>')
    scaling_chart(v, "total")
    raw("</div>")
    cuts, names, unit = TIERS[kind]
    bounds = [f"&lt; {cuts[0]:g} {unit}", f"{cuts[0]:g}–{cuts[1]:g} {unit}", f"&gt; {cuts[1]:g} {unit}"]
    tiers = "".join(f'<span><span class="op-dot" style="background:{c};margin:0"></span>{n} <small>({b})</small></span>'
                    for n, b, c in zip(names, bounds, TIER_COLORS))
    vendors = sorted(v["df"]["vendor"].dropna().unique(), key=lambda x: (symbol_of(kind, x) == "square", x))
    shapes = "".join(f'<span><span class="op-shape {symbol_of(kind, x)}"></span>{escape(x)}</span>' for x in vendors)
    raw(f'<div class="op-keys">{tiers}{shapes}</div></div>')


def accuracy_card(v):
    kind, bench = v["kind"], v["bench"]
    raw('<div class="op-card">')
    head(f"How accurate are the models on {BENCH[bench]}?",
         f"Typical error is the median absolute gap between measured and predicted, one value per {ONE[kind]}, from fits that "
         f"left it out. The 80% range should contain about 80% of {NOUN[kind]}.")
    val = v["val"]
    if val.empty:
        raw('<p class="op-lede">Model validation has not been exported yet.</p></div>')
        return
    a = val[val["slice"] == "All"]
    top = float(a["median_abs_pct_error"].max())
    rows = ""
    for _, r in a.iterrows():
        base = r["model"].startswith("Baseline")
        cov = "" if pd.isna(r["range_coverage_pct"]) else f'{r["range_coverage_pct"]:.0f}%'
        w = 100 * r["median_abs_pct_error"] / top if top else 0
        rows += (f'<tr class="{"op-base" if base else ""}"><td>{escape(r["model"])}</td>'
                 f'<td><span class="op-bar" style="width:{w * 0.9:.0f}px"></span>{r["median_abs_pct_error"]:.1f}%</td>'
                 f'<td>{cov}</td><td>{int(r["n_chips"])}</td></tr>')
    html = (f'<table class="op-acc"><thead><tr><th>Model</th><th>Typical error</th><th>Inside 80% range</th><th>{NOUN[kind]}</th></tr></thead>'
            f"<tbody>{rows}</tbody></table>")
    if bench == "blender":
        c = bl_chk[bl_chk["kind"] == kind] if not bl_chk.empty else bl_chk
        chk = ""
        for r in c.itertuples():
            gap = "—" if pd.isna(r.median_abs_gap_pct) else f"{r.median_abs_gap_pct:.1f}%"
            chk += (f"<tr><td>Blender {escape(str(r.check_version))}</td><td>{int(r.n_shared)}</td>"
                    f"<td>{gap}</td><td>{escape(r.status)}</td></tr>")
        passed = (bl_meta.get("passed") or {}).get(kind) or {}
        html += (f'<div class="op-cmp-wrap"><table class="op-acc"><thead><tr><th>Same fit on</th><th>Shared {NOUN[kind]}</th>'
                 f'<th>Median residual gap</th><th>Check</th></tr></thead><tbody>{chk}</tbody></table></div>'
                 f'<p class="op-foot"><strong>{"Used for assessment" if passed.get("passed") else "Shown only, not used for assessment"}.</strong> '
                 f'{escape(str(passed.get("reason", "")))}. The version check is a median: it supports stability on average, '
                 f'while a single product can move further. Errors by vendor, family and year are under Explore the evidence.</p>')
    else:
        html += ('<p class="op-foot">' + ("With few cards per group, these errors are rough. " if kind == "gpu" else "") +
                 "Errors by vendor, family and generation are under Explore the evidence.</p>")
    raw(html + "</div>")


def agreement_card(v):
    raw('<div class="op-card">')
    head("Do the models agree?", "Residual against the straight-line OLS model and the nonlinear model. "
         "Points far from the diagonal depend on the model chosen.")
    agreement(v)
    raw("</div>")


def spread_card(v):
    kind = v["kind"]
    raw('<div class="op-card">')
    if kind == "cpu":
        head("How much do submitted configurations vary?",
             "For each processor, the gap between its highest and lowest residual across submitted systems, memory, compilers "
             "and operating systems. Median per compiler group.")
    else:
        head("How much do submitted configurations vary?",
             "For each card, the gap between its highest and lowest residual across workstations and benchmark suites. Median per suite group.")
    spread_chart(v)
    raw('<p class="op-foot">' + (
        "Grouped by the compiler of each processor's typical submission (processor count in brackets). Groups differ in hardware "
        "and submission mix. Peak-versus-base compiler gain is a separate measurement, shown per processor." if kind == "cpu" else
        "Grouped by the suite of each card's typical submission (card count in brackets). Workload specialization (best workload "
        "against the composite) is a separate measurement, shown per card.") + "</p></div>")


def workloads():
    """Raw scores within one suite, version, OS and resolution: comparable as published."""
    raw('<div class="op-card">')
    head("Results by workload",
         "Published composite scores, grouped so that only results from the same suite and version, OS and "
         "resolution sit together. Nothing here is calibrated or combined, so every card SPEC measured appears, "
         "ranked or not.")
    if gpu_wl.empty:
        print(site.empty_state(gpu_wl_meta, "GPU results by workload"))
        raw("</div>")
        return
    groups = []
    for (suite, osf, res), g in gpu_wl.groupby(["suite", "os_family", "resolution"]):
        groups.append((suite, osf, res, g.sort_values("median_score", ascending=False)))
    groups.sort(key=lambda t: -len(t[3]))
    used = set() if gpu_cal.empty else set(gpu_cal.loc[gpu_cal["used_in_ranking"].astype(bool), "cohort"])
    opts, bodies = "", ""
    for i, (suite, osf, res, g) in enumerate(groups):
        base = suite.replace(" Linux", "")
        in_rank = f"{base} | {osf} | {res}" in used
        label = f"{suite} · {osf} · {res} ({len(g)} cards)"
        opts += f'<option value="{i}">{escape(label)}</option>'
        top = float(g["max_score"].max())
        rows = ""
        for r in g.itertuples():
            w = 100 * r.median_score / top if top else 0
            rng = "" if r.n_results < 2 else f"{r.min_score:,.1f} – {r.max_score:,.1f}"
            link = f' <a href="{escape(r.disclosure_url)}">disclosure</a>' if r.disclosure_url else ""
            oems = f"{r.n_oems}" if r.n_oems else "OEM unknown"
            rows += (f'<tr><td>{escape(r.processor)}<small>{escape(r.vendor)} · {escape(r.form_factor)}</small></td>'
                     f'<td><span class="op-bar" style="width:{w * 1.6:.0f}px"></span>{r.median_score:,.2f}</td>'
                     f'<td>{rng}</td><td>{r.n_results} · {oems}</td>'
                     f'<td>{escape(r.best_workload or "")}{link}</td></tr>')
        note = ("Included in the combined GPU ranking: its calibration passed the held-out check."
                if in_rank else "Not in the combined GPU ranking: its calibration did not pass the held-out check.")
        bodies += (f'<div class="op-wl" data-wl="{i}"{"" if i == 0 else " hidden"}>'
                   f'<p class="op-foot">Metric: the {escape(base)} composite as published by SPEC (higher is better). {note}</p>'
                   f'<div class="op-cmp-wrap"><table class="op-acc op-wl-table"><thead><tr><th>Card</th><th>Median composite</th>'
                   f'<th>Range</th><th>SPEC disclosures · OEMs</th><th>Best workload</th></tr></thead><tbody>{rows}</tbody></table></div></div>')
    raw(f'<div class="op-wl-pick"><label>Suite, OS and resolution <select aria-label="Suite, OS and resolution">{opts}</select></label></div>{bodies}</div>')


def calibration_card():
    raw('<div class="op-card">')
    head("Can the suites be combined?",
         "The GPU score puts different SPEC suites on one scale. Each suite is checked by refitting the "
         "calibration without one card at a time and asking whether that card lands where its other suites put it.")
    if gpu_cal.empty:
        print(site.empty_state(gpu_cal_meta, "GPU calibration check"))
        raw("</div>")
        return
    gap = gpu_cal_meta.get("max_gap_pct", 15)
    rows = ""
    for r in gpu_cal.sort_values(["used_in_ranking", "n_results"], ascending=[False, False]).itertuples():
        g = "—" if pd.isna(r.median_abs_gap_pct) else f"{r.median_abs_gap_pct:.1f}%"
        rows += (f'<tr><td>{escape(r.suite)}<small>{escape(r.os_family)} · {escape(r.resolution)}</small></td>'
                 f'<td>{r.n_results}</td><td>{r.n_cards}</td><td>{r.n_shared_cards}</td><td>{g}</td>'
                 f'<td>{escape(r.status)}</td><td>{"Yes" if r.used_in_ranking else "No"}</td></tr>')
    n_used = int(gpu_cal["used_in_ranking"].sum())
    raw(f'<div class="op-cmp-wrap"><table class="op-acc"><thead><tr><th>Suite</th><th>SPEC disclosures</th><th>Cards</th>'
        f'<th>Shared cards</th><th>Median gap</th><th>Check</th><th>In ranking</th></tr></thead><tbody>{rows}</tbody></table></div>'
        f'<p class="op-foot">A suite passes when at least {gpu_cal_meta.get("min_shared_cards", 3)} cards are also measured elsewhere and their '
        f'median gap is at most {gap:.0f}%. {n_used} of {len(gpu_cal)} suite groups pass and feed the GPU ranking; the reference '
        'scale is SPECviewperf 2020 v3 on Windows at FHD/QHD. A gap mixes calibration error with real differences between workloads, '
        'so a failing suite is not wrong, only not comparable on one scale. The calibration is refitted inside every leave-one-card-out fold.</p></div>')


def view(kind, bench):
    """One benchmark view for one kind: chart, inspector, comparison and model checks."""
    v = VIEWS[(kind, bench)]
    raw(f'<div class="op-view op-cat" data-kind="{kind}" data-bench="{bench}">')
    if v["df"].empty:
        print(site.empty_state(v["meta"], f"{NOUN[kind]} on {BENCH[bench]}"))
        raw("</div>")
        return
    main_card(v)
    compare(v)
    raw('<div class="op-pair">')
    agreement_card(v)
    accuracy_card(v)
    raw('</div><div class="op-pair">')
    scaling_card(v)
    if bench == "spec":
        spread_card(v)
    else:
        raw('<div class="op-card">')
        head("What the Blender model covers",
             f"Blender Open Data is a crowd-submitted rendering benchmark, so it covers consumer hardware that SPEC rarely sees. "
             f"Its verdicts are about rendering only: rendering rewards cores, clocks and power, so a cache-heavy {ONE[kind]} can sit "
             f"below prediction here and still lead in games or other workloads.")
        n_t = int(v["df"]["tracked"].sum())
        passed = (bl_meta.get("passed") or {}).get(kind) or {}
        inputs = ("cores, threads, clocks, L3, TDP, vendor and release year" if kind == "cpu" else
                  "shaders, clock, VRAM, bandwidth, release year, ray-tracing cores and the Blender backend (OptiX, HIP or oneAPI)")
        raw(f'<table class="op-acc"><tbody>'
            f'<tr><td>{NOUN[kind]} ranked</td><td>{len(v["df"]):,}</td></tr>'
            f'<tr><td>Tracked retail products among them</td><td>{n_t} of {len(tracked(kind))}</td></tr>'
            f'<tr><td>Benchmarked {NOUN[kind]} with specifications</td><td>{passed.get("n_with_specs", "—")} of {passed.get("n_benchmarked", "—")}</td></tr>'
            f'<tr><td>Blender version</td><td>{escape(str(BL_VERSION))}</td></tr>'
            f'<tr><td>Runs per product</td><td>at least {5}; median {int(v["df"]["n_runs"].median())}</td></tr>'
            f'</tbody></table><p class="op-foot">Inputs: {inputs}. Specifications come from tables in this repository, entered from '
            f'manufacturers\' reference figures. Blender Open Data collected {day(SRC_DATES.get("blender_opendata"))}; CC0.</p></div>')
    raw("</div>")
    if kind == "gpu" and bench == "spec":
        workloads()
        calibration_card()
    raw("</div>")
```

```{python}
A_CLASS = {tvcat.ASSESSED: "op-a-assessed", tvcat.MEASURED_ONLY: "op-a-measured", tvcat.NO_MEASUREMENT: "op-a-none"}
A_CODE = {tvcat.ASSESSED: "assessed", tvcat.MEASURED_ONLY: "measured", tvcat.NO_MEASUREMENT: "none"}
A_ORDER = {tvcat.ASSESSED: 0, tvcat.MEASURED_ONLY: 1, tvcat.NO_MEASUREMENT: 2}


def spec_disclosures(n, oems):
    """SPEC evidence for a catalogue row. Some collectors (SPECworkstation CPU) do not record the OEM."""
    n = int(n or 0)
    if not n:
        return "0"
    oem = "OEM unknown" if not oems or pd.isna(oems) or int(oems) == 0 else f"{int(oems)} OEM{'s' if int(oems) != 1 else ''}"
    return f"{n}<small>{oem}</small>"


def tracked_list(kind):
    """Every tracked product, then other SPEC-measured hardware, with both benchmarks' assessments."""
    if cat.empty or "assessment" not in cat.columns:
        print(site.empty_state(cat_meta, "Hardware catalogue"))
        return
    c = cat[cat["kind"] == kind]
    extra = c[~c["tracked"].astype(bool) & (c["assessment"] != tvcat.NO_MEASUREMENT)]
    t = tracked(kind)
    first_day = None if HIST.empty else str(HIST["date"].min())
    gen_day = str(cat_meta.get("generated_at") or "")[:10]
    rows = []
    for grp, part in (("t", t), ("x", extra)):
        part = part.assign(_o=part["assessment"].map(A_ORDER)).sort_values(["_o", "name"])
        for r in part.itertuples():
            sub = []
            if pd.notna(r.price_usd):
                sub.append(f"${r.price_usd:,.0f}" + (f" on {r.price_date}" if r.price_date else ""))
            if pd.notna(r.value_rank):
                sub.append(f"value #{int(r.value_rank)} of {int(r.value_n)}")
            if grp == "x":
                sub.append("not sold by a tracked retailer")
            new = ""
            ft = getattr(r, "first_tracked", None)
            if grp == "t" and ft and first_day and ft > first_day and gen_day and \
                    (pd.Timestamp(gen_day) - pd.Timestamp(ft)).days <= 7:
                new = f'<span class="op-badge op-new" title="First tracked {ft}">New</span>'
            if pd.notna(r.measured_value):
                meas = f"{_fmt(r.measured_value)}<small>{escape(str(r.measured_metric))}</small>"
                if r.measured_groups and r.measured_groups > 1 and not r.on_residuals:
                    meas = meas[:-8] + f"; results in {int(r.measured_groups)} suite groups</small>"
            else:
                meas = "—"
            runs = r.blender_runs
            bl_ev = (f"{int(runs):,}<small>Blender {r.blender_score:,.0f}</small>"
                     if runs is not None and pd.notna(runs) else "0")
            lines = []
            if getattr(r, "on_blender_residuals", False):
                lines.append(f'<span class="op-bench-line"><b>Blender rendering:</b> {escape(r.blender_verdict or "Near prediction")} · '
                             f'{r.blender_residual_pct:+.1f}% vs OLS <button type="button" class="op-tl-go" data-key="{escape(r.model_key)}" '
                             f'data-bench="blender">Inspect</button></span>')
            else:
                lines.append(f'<span class="op-bench-line"><b>Blender rendering:</b> not assessed · {escape(r.blender_reason or "no Blender result")}</span>')
            if r.on_residuals:
                d = f"{escape(r.consensus_verdict or 'Near prediction')} · {r.residual_pct:+.1f}% vs OLS"
                if r.coverage_status == tvcat.LIMITED:
                    d += " · limited evidence"
                lines.append(f'<span class="op-bench-line"><b>SPEC workloads:</b> {d} <button type="button" class="op-tl-go" '
                             f'data-key="{escape(r.model_key)}" data-bench="spec">Inspect</button></span>')
            else:
                lines.append(f'<span class="op-bench-line"><b>SPEC workloads:</b> not assessed · {escape(r.coverage_status)}'
                             + (f" · {escape(r.reason)}" if r.reason else "") + "</span>")
            nxt = escape(r.next_source or "") or "—"
            q = escape(f"{r.name} {r.model_key}".lower())
            rows.append(
                f'<tr data-g="{grp}" data-a="{A_CODE[r.assessment]}" data-q="{q}"{"" if grp == "t" else " hidden"}>'
                f'<td>{escape(r.name)}{new}<small>{" · ".join(escape(x) for x in sub) or "&nbsp;"}</small></td>'
                f'<td><span class="op-badge {A_CLASS[r.assessment]}">{escape(r.assessment)}</span>{"".join(lines)}</td>'
                f'<td>{bl_ev}</td><td>{spec_disclosures(r.measured_n, r.spec_oems)}</td><td>{meas}</td>'
                f'<td><small>{nxt}</small></td></tr>')
    n_t, n_x = len(t), len(extra)
    raw(f"""<div class="op-tl-box" data-kind="{kind}">
<div class="op-tl-bar">
<div class="tv-seg" role="group" aria-label="Which products">
<button type="button" data-g="t" aria-pressed="true">Tracked ({n_t})</button>
<button type="button" data-g="x" aria-pressed="false">Other SPEC hardware ({n_x})</button>
<button type="button" data-g="all" aria-pressed="false">All ({n_t + n_x})</button></div>
<select data-tl="a" aria-label="Model assessment">
<option value="">Any assessment</option><option value="assessed">Assessed</option>
<option value="queue">Audit queue (not assessed)</option><option value="measured">Measured, not assessed</option>
<option value="none">No measurement</option></select>
<input type="search" data-tl="q" placeholder="Search {NOUN[kind]}" aria-label="Search {NOUN[kind]}">
<span class="op-tl-count" aria-live="polite"></span>
</div>
<div class="op-tl-wrap"><table class="op-tl"><thead><tr><th>Product</th><th>Assessment, by benchmark</th><th>Blender runs</th>
<th>SPEC disclosures</th><th>SPEC measurement</th><th>Where a result could come from</th></tr></thead><tbody>{"".join(rows)}</tbody></table></div>
<p class="op-foot">Assessed: ranked by the Blender rendering model, the SPEC models, or both; each benchmark's line says which.
The SPEC models need at least {cpu_meta.get("min_results", 3) if kind == "cpu" else gpu_meta.get("min_results", 2)} SPEC disclosures and the
Blender model at least 5 runs in Blender {escape(str(BL_VERSION))}. Measured, not assessed: a published SPEC result exists but is below that
threshold or only in suites that cannot be combined. OEM unknown: the collector for that source does not record who submitted the result.
{"CPU SPEC measurements are the median SPECrate 2017 Int base per socket." if kind == "cpu" else "GPU SPEC measurements below the threshold are published composites, named with their suite, OS and resolution; they compare only with results from that same group (see Results by workload)."}
SPEC collected {day(SRC_DATES.get("spec_cpu2017" if kind == "cpu" else "spec_gwpg"))}; Blender Open Data collected {day(SRC_DATES.get("blender_opendata"))}.</p>
</div>""")


def blender_table(kind):
    """Every product the Blender rendering model ranked."""
    b = VIEWS[(kind, "blender")]["df"]
    if b.empty:
        print(site.empty_state(bl_meta, "Blender residuals"))
        return
    rows = []
    for r in b.sort_values("residual_pct", ascending=False).itertuples():
        price = PRICE.get((kind, r.key))
        sub = [f"{int(r.n_runs):,} Blender runs", r.backend if kind == "gpu" else ""]
        if price:
            sub.append(f"${price[0]:,.0f}")
        rng = ""
        if pd.notna(r.pred_ols_lo) and pd.notna(r.pred_ols_hi):
            rng = f"<small>80% range {r.pred_ols_lo:,.0f}–{r.pred_ols_hi:,.0f}</small>"
        flag = f"<small>{escape(r.outside_training_range)}</small>" if isinstance(r.outside_training_range, str) and r.outside_training_range else ""
        q = escape(f"{r.processor} {r.key}".lower())
        rows.append(
            f'<tr data-g="{"t" if r.tracked else "x"}" data-q="{q}"{"" if r.tracked else " hidden"}>'
            f'<td>{escape(r.processor)}<small>{" · ".join(escape(x) for x in sub if x)}</small></td>'
            f'<td>{r.measured_score:,.0f}</td><td>{r.pred_ols:,.0f}{rng}</td>'
            f'<td>{r.residual_pct:+.1f}%<small>structural {r.structural_residual_pct:+.1f}% · GBDT {r.gbdt_residual_pct:+.1f}%</small></td>'
            f'<td>{escape(r.consensus_verdict)}{flag} <button type="button" class="op-tl-go" data-key="{escape(r.key)}" data-bench="blender">Inspect</button></td></tr>')
    n_t = int(b["tracked"].sum())
    raw(f"""<div class="op-tl-box" data-kind="{kind}">
<div class="op-tl-bar">
<div class="tv-seg" role="group" aria-label="Which products">
<button type="button" data-g="t" aria-pressed="true">Tracked ({n_t})</button>
<button type="button" data-g="x" aria-pressed="false">Not tracked ({len(b) - n_t})</button>
<button type="button" data-g="all" aria-pressed="false">All ({len(b)})</button></div>
<input type="search" data-tl="q" placeholder="Search {NOUN[kind]}" aria-label="Search {NOUN[kind]}">
<span class="op-tl-count" aria-live="polite"></span>
</div>
<div class="op-tl-wrap"><table class="op-tl"><thead><tr><th>Product</th><th>Blender score</th><th>Predicted (OLS)</th>
<th>Residual vs OLS</th><th>Verdict across models</th></tr></thead><tbody>{"".join(rows)}</tbody></table></div>
<p class="op-foot">Blender Open Data {escape(str(BL_VERSION))}, median score per product. Typical held-out error: {err_line(VIEWS[(kind, "blender")])}.</p>
</div>""")


LABELS = {
    "processor": "Chip", "class": "Classification", "measured": "Measured",
    "pred_ols": "OLS predicted", "residual_pct": "OLS %",
    "pred_structural": "Structural predicted", "structural_residual_pct": "Structural %",
    "pred_nonlinear": "Nonlinear predicted", "gbdt_residual_pct": "Nonlinear %",
    "model_spread_pts": "Model spread (pts)", "outside_training_range": "Outside training range",
    "tuning_spread_pct": "Config spread (pts)", "peak_gain_pct": "Peak vs base gain %",
    "workload_specialization_pct": "Workload specialization %",
    "n_results": "SPEC disclosures", "n_oems": "OEMs", "n_systems": "Systems", "n_configs": "Configurations",
    "cores_per_chip": "Cores/chip", "l3_mb_per_core": "L3 MB/core", "score_per_core": "Score/core",
    "first_avail": "First available", "compiler_family": "Compiler",
    "first_test_date": "First test", "last_test_date": "Last test",
    "config_memory": "Memory tested", "config_system": "System", "Disclosure": "Disclosure",
    "vram_gb": "VRAM GB", "bandwidth_gbps": "Bandwidth GB/s", "form_factor": "Form factor",
    "suites_tested": "Suites",
}


def ranking(kind):
    df = VIEWS[(kind, "spec")]["df"]
    table = df.assign(
        **{"class": df["cls"].map(lambda c: CLASSES[c][0]), "measured": df["y"],
           "Disclosure": [f'<a href="{u}">report</a>' if u else "" for u in df["disclosure_url"]]}
    )
    cols = ["processor", "class", "measured", "pred_ols", "residual_pct", "pred_structural",
            "structural_residual_pct", "pred_nonlinear", "gbdt_residual_pct", "model_spread_pts",
            "outside_training_range", "tuning_spread_pct"]
    if kind == "cpu":
        cols += ["peak_gain_pct", "n_results", "n_oems", "n_systems", "n_configs", "cores_per_chip",
                 "l3_mb_per_core", "score_per_core", "compiler_family", "first_avail", "first_test_date",
                 "last_test_date", "config_memory", "Disclosure"]
    else:
        cols += ["workload_specialization_pct", "n_results", "n_oems", "n_systems", "n_configs",
                 "cores_per_chip", "vram_gb", "bandwidth_gbps", "form_factor", "suites_tested",
                 "first_avail", "config_system", "Disclosure"]
    table = table[cols].rename(columns=LABELS)
    if kind == "gpu":
        table = table.rename(columns={"Cores/chip": "Shaders", "First available": "Released"})
    show(table.round(1), paging=True, pageLength=25, order=[[4, "desc"]], showIndex=False,
         classes="display compact", allow_html=True, lengthMenu=[25, 100, 1000])


def breakdown(kind):
    g = group_table(VIEWS[(kind, "spec")]["df"]).rename(columns={
        "compiler_family": "Compiler" if kind == "cpu" else "Suite", "chips": NOUN[kind],
        "disclosures": "SPEC disclosures", "spread": "Median config spread (pts)",
        "configs": "Median configurations per chip", "ols": "Median OLS %", "nonlinear": "Median nonlinear %",
    })
    show(g.round(1), paging=False, showIndex=False, classes="display compact")


def validation(kind, bench):
    v = val_frame(kind, bench)
    if v.empty:
        display(Markdown("Validation has not been exported yet."))
        return
    t = v.drop(columns=[c for c in ("kind",) if c in v.columns]).rename(columns={
        "slice": "Slice", "group": "Group", "model": "Model", "n_chips": NOUN[kind],
        "median_abs_pct_error": "Typical error %", "mean_abs_log_error": "Mean abs log error",
        "range_coverage_pct": "Inside 80% range %"})
    show(t.round(3), paging=True, pageLength=25, showIndex=False, classes="display compact")


def summary(title, note):
    print(f"<summary><b>{title}</b><span>{note}</span>{icon('chev', 'op-chev')}</summary>")
```

```{python}
        BlenderA=yes(cat["on_blender_residuals"]), SpecA=yes(cat["on_residuals"]), OEMs=oem,
        Runs=cat["blender_runs"].map(lambda v: f"{int(v):,}" if pd.notna(v) else ""),
    )[["Kind", "name", "assessment", "BlenderA", "Runs", "blender_score", "SpecA", "coverage_status", "reason",
       "measured_n", "OEMs", "Value", "Fair", "price_usd", "price_date", "benchmarks_collected"]].rename(columns={
        "name": "Product", "assessment": "Assessment", "BlenderA": "Blender assessed", "Runs": "Blender runs",
        "blender_score": "Blender score", "SpecA": "SPEC assessed", "coverage_status": "SPEC status",
        "reason": "SPEC reason", "measured_n": "SPEC disclosures", "OEMs": "SPEC OEMs",
        "Value": "On Value ranking", "Fair": "On Fair price", "price_usd": "Price (USD)", "price_date": "Price date",

    t["Price date"] = t["Price date"].fillna("")
    # Products shown on the other two pages first, so the gaps that matter are at the top.
    on_pages = (t["On Value ranking"] != "") | (t["On Fair price"] != "")
    t = pd.concat([t[on_pages], t[~on_pages]])

         lengthMenu=[25, 100, 2000], maxBytes=0)
```

**Assessed**: ranked by at least one model, Blender rendering or SPEC. The SPEC status says why a
product is or is not ranked on SPEC: **Measured**: ranked, with at least four SPEC disclosures
from more than one OEM. **Limited evidence**: ranked on fewer disclosures or a single OEM, or
below the minimum. **Missing specifications**: SPEC results exist but the card is not in the
specification table. **Parsing failure**: a SPEC row names the product but no score could be
read. **Results not found**: no SPEC result in the collected suites, either because none is
published or because the source does not cover that kind of product (SPEC GWPG is workstation
submissions, so consumer graphics cards rarely appear). **SPEC OEMs: Unknown** means the
collector does not record who submitted the result (SPECworkstation CPU scores). Products on
Value ranking or Fair price are listed first.
:::
</details>

**Config spread** is the gap, in percentage points, between a chip's highest and lowest OLS
residual across its submitted results. It measures how much the submitted configurations
(system, memory, compiler, operating system, or for GPUs the workstation and suite) move the
score. It is not a tuning gain. Two other measurements are kept separate: the CPU **peak versus
base compiler gain** (SPEC's peak run against its base run on the same system) and the GPU
**workload specialization** (best single workload against the composite).
:::
</details>
