<details class="op-detail">
```{python}
#| output: asis
summary("Models, definitions &amp; limitations", "OLS · Structural L1 · Nonlinear GBDT · both benchmarks · provenance")
```
::: {.op-detail-body}

**Two benchmarks, never combined.** Blender rendering and SPEC workloads each have their own
three models, fitted on their own scores. A product can carry an assessment from both; the page
shows one benchmark at a time, and the comparison panel labels every row with its benchmark.

**Held out by product.** Every product is scored by models refitted without any of its results.
For SPEC CPUs, single-socket "P" parts (such as EPYC 9454P) are held out together with the part
of the same silicon (EPYC 9454). For Blender, products with identical specifications are held
out together. A residual is how far the measured score is above (positive) or below (negative)
the prediction. SPEC CPUs need at least `{python} cpu_meta.get("min_results", 3)` disclosures
to be ranked, SPEC GPUs at least `{python} gpu_meta.get("min_results", 2)`, and Blender
products at least 5 runs in one Blender version.

**Scores.** Blender scores are the median Blender Benchmark score (samples per minute over three
scenes) in Blender `{python} BL_VERSION`, never combined across versions. SPEC CPU scores are
SPECrate 2017 Integer base per socket, the median over a processor's results. SPEC GPU scores
combine several SPEC GWPG suites, each put on the SPECviewperf 2020 v3 (Windows, FHD/QHD) scale
before fitting, so a GPU score is this site's estimate, not a SPEC metric. Only suites that pass
the held-out check in "Can the suites be combined?" feed the ranking.

**The three models.**

* **OLS** is a plain regression in logs on the product's specifications (SPEC CPUs: cores,
  clock, chips, SMT, L2 and L3 cache per core, vintage and vendor; SPEC GPUs: shaders, boost
  clock, VRAM, memory bandwidth, mobile form factor and vendor; Blender CPUs: cores, threads,
  clocks, L3, TDP, vendor and year; Blender GPUs: shaders, clock, VRAM, bandwidth, year,
  ray-tracing cores and backend).
* **Structural L1** is a robust regression that lets returns to core or shader count diminish,
  with cache and bandwidth interactions.
* **Nonlinear GBDT** is a gradient-boosted tree model with median loss over the same
  specifications.

**Verdicts are agreement, not confidence.** *Above prediction across models*: above all three
predictions (CPUs: OLS +10% or more, structural and nonlinear +8% or more, and OLS and nonlinear
within 25 points). *Below prediction across models*: below all three (CPUs: −10%, −8%, −8%).
*Model-sensitive*: high on the straight-line OLS but much smaller once nonlinear scaling is
allowed for. Everything else is *near prediction*. GPU thresholds are similar. A verdict says the
models agree on the direction. How far to trust one product's residual comes from the typical
held-out error of that benchmark's models and from the 80% range, both shown beside each
verdict.

**Ranges and flags.** A product's 80% range is its prediction widened by the 10th and 90th
percentiles of every other product's residual for that model. **Model spread** is the gap
between the highest and lowest of the three residuals. **Outside training range** names any
specification on which the product is beyond every other one, where predictions extrapolate.
**Limited evidence** marks a SPEC chip with fewer than four disclosures or every disclosure from
one OEM, and a Blender product with fewer than `{python} BL_FEW_RUNS` runs.

```{python}
#| output: asis
v = cpu_meta.get("verdict") or {}
if v:
    print(f"**Does the SPEC CPU model carry signal at all?** {v['statement']} See "
          "[Model and leaderboard](model.qmd).\n")
```

**Provenance.** Benchmarks: Blender Open Data collected `{python} day(SRC_DATES.get("blender_opendata"))`,
SPEC CPU 2017 collected `{python} collected(cpu_meta)`, SPEC GWPG collected `{python} collected(gpu_meta)`.
SPEC CPU specifications come from each SPEC disclosure. GPU and Blender CPU specifications come
from tables kept in this repository. Prices, where shown, are the dated lowest new listing used on
Value ranking and Fair price.

**Limitations.** A residual flags unexplained performance; it is not a quality score.
Architecture, memory configuration, compiler, BIOS settings, cooling and model fit all
contribute. SPEC submitters choose which configurations to submit; Blender Open Data is
crowd-submitted and uncontrolled. The spread and scaling charts describe the submitted results
and do not separate these causes.

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(site.finding_line(cpu_meta.get("finding")))
for m in (bl_meta, cpu_meta, gpu_meta):
    for line in m.get("limitations", []):
        print(f"* {line}")
    print()
    print(site.source_note(m))
    print()
```

from pathlib import Path as _P
print("\n```{=html}\n<script>" + _P("tv-pick.js").read_text() + "</script>\n```\n")

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const MODELS = { ols: "OLS", structural: "Structural L1", nonlinear: "Nonlinear GBDT" };
  const BENCH = { blender: "Blender rendering", spec: "SPEC workloads" };
  const signed = v => v == null ? "—" : `${v > 0 ? "+" : v < 0 ? "−" : ""}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(1)}%`;
  const num = v => v == null ? "—" : v.toLocaleString("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: v < 100 ? 1 : 0 });
  const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]));
  const mainGraph = cat => cat.querySelector(".op-main .js-plotly-plot");
  const state = { kind: "cpu", bench: "blender" };
  const views = [];

  document.querySelectorAll(".op-cat").forEach(cat => {
    const pick = cat.querySelector(".op-pick");
    if (!pick) return;
    const chips = JSON.parse(pick.dataset.chips);
    const errs = JSON.parse(pick.dataset.errs || "{}");
    const select = pick.querySelector("select");
    const field = f => pick.querySelector(`[data-f="${f}"]`);
    const kind = cat.dataset.kind, bench = cat.dataset.bench;
    const noun = kind === "cpu" ? "CPUs" : "GPUs";
    const byKey = k => chips.find(d => d.key === k);
    const byName = n => chips.find(d => d.name === n);
    cat._opModel = "ols";
    // A product picked on another Tech Value page, or in a shared link, replaces the default.
    const shared = byKey(window.TVPick?.get(kind));
    if (shared) select.value = shared.key;

    // Peer filters: narrow the main chart to comparable products and say where the pick sits.
    const bar = cat.querySelector(".op-peers");
    const pv = n => bar?.querySelector(`[data-peer="${n}"]`)?.value ?? "";
    const pn = n => { const v = pv(n); return v === "" ? null : Number(v); };
    let peerSet = null;
    const peerCount = () => {
      if (!bar) return;
      const ok = peerSet ? chips.filter(c => peerSet.has(c.name)) : chips;
      const m = cat._opModel;
      const res = ok.map(c => c.preds[m].r).sort((a, b) => a - b);
      const mid = res.length ? (res[Math.floor((res.length - 1) / 2)] + res[Math.ceil((res.length - 1) / 2)]) / 2 : null;
      const sel = byKey(select.value);
      let txt = `${ok.length} of ${chips.length} ${noun} shown`;
      if (mid != null) txt += ` · median residual vs ${MODELS[m]} ${signed(mid)}`;
      if (sel && ok.includes(sel)) txt += ` · ${sel.name} ranks ${1 + ok.filter(c => c.preds[m].r > sel.preds[m].r).length} of ${ok.length} by residual`;
      else if (sel) txt += ` · ${sel.name} is outside these filters`;
      if (pn("p0") != null || pn("p1") != null) txt += " · price filters keep only products with a retail price";
      bar.querySelector(".op-peer-count").textContent = txt;
    };
    const applyPeers = () => {
      if (!bar) return;
      const f = { tracked: pv("tracked"), vendor: pv("vendor"), group: pv("group"), form: pv("form"), g0: pn("gen0"), g1: pn("gen1"),
                  c0: pn("c0"), c1: pn("c1"), p0: pn("p0"), p1: pn("p1") };
      const priced = f.p0 != null || f.p1 != null;
      const ok = chips.filter(c => (!f.tracked || c.tracked) && (!f.vendor || c.vendor === f.vendor) && (!f.group || c.group === f.group)
        && (!f.form || c.form === f.form)
        && (c.gen == null || ((f.g0 == null || c.gen >= f.g0) && (f.g1 == null || c.gen <= f.g1)))
        && (f.c0 == null || c.cores >= f.c0) && (f.c1 == null || c.cores <= f.c1)
        && (!priced || (c.price != null && (f.p0 == null || c.price >= f.p0) && (f.p1 == null || c.price <= f.p1))));
      peerSet = new Set(ok.map(c => c.name));
      const g = mainGraph(cat);
      if (g && window.Plotly && g.data) {
        const idx = [], xs = [], ys = [], cds = [];
        g.data.forEach((t, i) => {
          if (!t.name?.startsWith("m:")) return;
          if (!t._opAll) t._opAll = { x: Array.from(t.x), y: Array.from(t.y), c: Array.from(t.customdata) };
          const keep = t._opAll.c.map(cd => peerSet.has(cd[0]));
          idx.push(i);
          xs.push(t._opAll.x.filter((_, j) => keep[j]));
          ys.push(t._opAll.y.filter((_, j) => keep[j]));
          cds.push(t._opAll.c.filter((_, j) => keep[j]));
        });
        if (idx.length) Plotly.restyle(g, { x: xs, y: ys, customdata: cds }, idx);
      }
      peerCount();
    };
    if (bar) {
      bar.addEventListener("change", applyPeers);
      bar.addEventListener("input", e => { if (e.target.tagName === "INPUT") applyPeers(); });
      bar.querySelector('[data-peer="reset"]').addEventListener("click", () => {
        bar.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(i => { i.value = ""; });
        bar.querySelectorAll("select").forEach(s => {
          s.selectedIndex = s.dataset.peer === "gen1" ? s.options.length - 1 : 0;
        });
        applyPeers();
      });
    }

    const update = () => {
      const c = byKey(select.value) || chips[0];
      peerCount();
      field("name").textContent = c.name;
      field("cls").textContent = c.cls;
      let rows = `<tr class="op-measured"><td>Measured</td><td>${num(c.y)}</td><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr>`;
      for (const [k, label] of Object.entries(MODELS)) {
        const p = c.preds[k];
        const range = p.lo == null ? "—" : `${num(p.lo)} – ${num(p.hi)}`;
        const e = errs[k] == null ? "—" : `${errs[k].toFixed(1)}%`;
        rows += `<tr><td>${label}</td><td>${num(p.p)}</td><td>${range}</td><td class="${p.r >= 0 ? "op-pos" : "op-negv"}">${signed(p.r)}</td><td class="op-err">${e}</td></tr>`;
      }
      field("preds").innerHTML = rows;
      const flags = [`Model spread ${c.spread.toFixed(1)} pts`];
      if (c.oor) flags.push(`Outside training range: ${c.oor}`);
      if (c.limited) flags.push(c.limited);
      if (!c.tracked) flags.push("Not sold by a tracked retailer");
      const warn = c.oor || c.limited;
      field("flags").innerHTML = (warn ? `<svg class="op-ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3l10 18H2z"/><path d="M12 10v5M12 18v.5"/></svg> ` : "") + esc(flags.join(" · "));
      field("flags").style.color = warn ? "" : "var(--op-muted)";
      field("facts").innerHTML = c.facts.map(([k, v]) => `<div><span>${esc(k)}</span><b>${esc(v)}</b></div>`).join("");
      field("link").innerHTML = c.url ? `<a href="${esc(c.url)}">Typical SPEC disclosure</a>` : "";
      const g = mainGraph(cat);
      if (!g || !window.Plotly || !g.data) return;
      const idx = g.data.findIndex(t => t.name === "selected");
      if (idx >= 0) Plotly.restyle(g, { x: [[c.preds[cat._opModel].p]], y: [[c.y]] }, [idx]);
    };
    // Choose a product by key (from the search, a list or another page). Returns false if this view lacks it.
    const choose = (key, record) => {
      const c = byKey(key);
      if (!c) return false;
      select.value = c.key;
      if (record) window.TVPick?.set(kind, c.key);
      if (bar && !c.tracked && pv("tracked")) { bar.querySelector('[data-peer="tracked"]').value = ""; applyPeers(); }
      update();
      return true;
    };
    select.addEventListener("change", () => {
      const c = byKey(select.value);
      if (c) window.TVPick?.set(kind, c.key);
      update();
    });
    const g = mainGraph(cat);
    if (g?.on) g.on("plotly_click", ev => {
      const c = byName(ev.points?.[0]?.customdata?.[0]);
      if (c) { select.value = c.key; select.dispatchEvent(new Event("change")); }
    });
    cat.querySelectorAll("button[data-model]").forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const m = btn.dataset.model;
      cat._opModel = m;
      cat.querySelectorAll("button[data-model]").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b === btn)));
      const graph = mainGraph(cat);
      if (graph && window.Plotly) {
        const idx = [], vis = [];
        graph.data.forEach((t, i) => { if (t.name?.startsWith("m:")) { idx.push(i); vis.push(t.name.startsWith(`m:${m}:`)); } });
        Plotly.restyle(graph, { visible: vis }, idx);
        Plotly.relayout(graph, { "xaxis.title.text": `Predicted by ${MODELS[m]} (log scale)` });
      }
      update();
    }));
    cat.querySelectorAll("button[data-alt]").forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const card = btn.closest(".op-card");
      card.querySelectorAll("button[data-alt]").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b === btn)));
      card.querySelectorAll(".op-alt").forEach(d => { d.hidden = d.dataset.alt !== btn.dataset.alt; });
      card.querySelectorAll(".op-alt:not([hidden]) .js-plotly-plot").forEach(gr => { if (window.Plotly) { Plotly.Plots.resize(gr); fitPhone(gr); } });
    }));
    views.push({ kind, bench, cat, byKey, choose, update, applyPeers, current: () => select.value });
  });
  const viewOf = (kind, bench) => views.find(v => v.kind === kind && v.bench === bench);

  // Phone width: thin the tick labels and shorten axis titles so nothing is clipped.
  function fitPhone(g) {
    if (!g || !window.Plotly || g._opPhone || g.offsetWidth === 0 || g.offsetWidth >= 600) return;
    g._opPhone = true;
    const upd = { "margin.l": Math.min(g.layout.margin.l, 56) };
    for (const ax of ["xaxis", "yaxis"]) {
      const a = g.layout[ax], t = a.title?.text || "";
      if (t.startsWith("Measured:")) upd[`${ax}.title.text`] = "Measured";
      else if (t.length > 30) upd[`${ax}.title.text`] = t.replace(" (log scale)", "").replace("Median spread across submitted configurations", "Median spread");
      if (a.tickvals && a.ticktext && a.tickvals.length > 7) {
        upd[`${ax}.tickvals`] = a.tickvals.filter((_, i) => i % 2 === 0);
        upd[`${ax}.ticktext`] = a.ticktext.filter((_, i) => i % 2 === 0);
      }
    }
    Plotly.relayout(g, upd);
  }
  const writeHash = () => {
    const h = [state.kind === "gpu" ? "gpu" : "", state.bench === "spec" ? "spec" : ""].filter(Boolean).join("-");
    try { history.replaceState(history.state, "", h ? "#" + h : location.pathname + location.search); } catch (e) {}
  };
  const show = (kind, bench) => {
    state.kind = kind; state.bench = bench;
    document.body.classList.toggle("op-gpu", kind === "gpu");
    document.body.classList.toggle("op-spec", bench === "spec");
    document.querySelectorAll(".tv-switch button[data-tab]").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.tab === kind)));
    document.querySelectorAll(".tv-switch button[data-bench]").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.bench === bench)));
    document.querySelectorAll(`.op-cat[data-kind="${kind}"][data-bench="${bench}"]`).forEach(cat => {
      cat.querySelectorAll(".js-plotly-plot").forEach(g => { if (window.Plotly && g.offsetWidth) { Plotly.Plots.resize(g); fitPhone(g); } });
    });
    const v = viewOf(kind, bench);
    if (v) { v.update(); window.TVPick?.render(kind, v.current()); }
    document.querySelectorAll(`.op-cmp[data-kind="${kind}"][data-bench="${bench}"]`).forEach(b => b._opDraw?.());
  };
  document.querySelectorAll(".tv-switch button[data-tab]").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => { show(b.dataset.tab, state.bench); writeHash(); }));
  document.querySelectorAll(".tv-switch button[data-bench]").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => { show(state.kind, b.dataset.bench); writeHash(); }));

  // Open on what the link asks for; otherwise on Blender, unless the shared pick is only assessed on SPEC.
  const hash = location.hash.slice(1).split("-");
  const kind0 = hash.includes("gpu") || window.TVPick?.urlKind() === "gpu" ? "gpu" : "cpu";
  let bench0 = hash.includes("spec") ? "spec" : "blender";
  const shared0 = window.TVPick?.get(kind0);
  if (!hash.includes("spec") && shared0 && !viewOf(kind0, "blender")?.byKey(shared0) && viewOf(kind0, "spec")?.byKey(shared0)) bench0 = "spec";
  views.forEach(v => v.applyPeers());
  show(kind0, bench0);

  // Jump to a product: switch to a benchmark that assesses it, select it and scroll to the inspector.
  const goTo = (kind, key, bench) => {
    const order = bench ? [bench] : [state.bench, state.bench === "spec" ? "blender" : "spec"];
    for (const b of order) {
      const v = viewOf(kind, b);
      if (v && v.byKey(key)) {
        if (b !== state.bench || kind !== state.kind) { show(kind, b); writeHash(); }
        v.choose(key, true);
        v.cat.querySelector(".op-pick")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
        return b;
      }
    }
    window.TVPick?.set(kind, key);
    return null;
  };

  // Find a product: any catalogue entry; the summary card shows what every page says about it.
  document.querySelectorAll(".op-find").forEach(box => {
    const kind = box.dataset.kind;
    const input = box.querySelector("input");
    const msg = box.querySelector(".op-find-msg");
    if (!window.TVPick) return;
    TVPick.load().then(all => {
      const mine = all.filter(r => r.kind === kind);
      const pickIt = () => {
        const r = mine.find(x => x.name === input.value) || mine.find(x => x.name.toLowerCase() === input.value.trim().toLowerCase());
        if (!r) { msg.textContent = input.value ? "Pick a name from the list." : ""; return; }
        const b = goTo(kind, r.model_key);
        msg.textContent = b ? `Showing ${r.name} on ${BENCH[b]}.`
          : `${r.name} is not assessed on either benchmark yet. The summary below says why.`;
      };
      input.addEventListener("change", pickIt);
    });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll(".op-wl-pick select").forEach(sel => sel.addEventListener("change", () => {
    const card = sel.closest(".op-card");
    card.querySelectorAll(".op-wl").forEach(d => { d.hidden = d.dataset.wl !== sel.value; });
  }));

  // Product lists: which group, assessment filter, search, and Inspect links.
  document.querySelectorAll(".op-tl-box").forEach(box => {
    const rows = [...box.querySelectorAll("tbody tr")];
    const sel = box.querySelector('[data-tl="a"]');
    const q = box.querySelector('[data-tl="q"]');
    const count = box.querySelector(".op-tl-count");
    const kind = box.dataset.kind;
    const noun = kind === "cpu" ? "CPUs" : "GPUs";
    let grp = "t";
    const apply = () => {
      const a = sel ? sel.value : "", text = q.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      let shown = 0, inGroup = 0;
      rows.forEach(r => {
        const g = grp === "all" || r.dataset.g === grp;
        if (g) inGroup++;
        const okA = !a || (a === "queue" ? r.dataset.a !== "assessed" : r.dataset.a === a);
        const ok = g && okA && (!text || r.dataset.q.includes(text));
        r.hidden = !ok;
        if (ok) shown++;
      });
      count.textContent = `Showing ${shown} of ${inGroup} ${noun}`;
    };
    box.querySelectorAll("button[data-g]").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
      grp = b.dataset.g;
      box.querySelectorAll("button[data-g]").forEach(x => x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(x === b)));
      apply();
    }));
    if (sel) sel.addEventListener("change", apply);
    q.addEventListener("input", apply);
    box.addEventListener("click", e => {
      const go = e.target.closest(".op-tl-go");
      if (go) goTo(kind, go.dataset.key, go.dataset.bench);
    });
    apply();
  });

  // Two-product comparison from the shared catalogue: both benchmarks, the selected one first.
  const usd = v => "$" + Math.round(v).toLocaleString("en-US");
  const diff = (a, b) => (a && b ? signed(100 * (b / a - 1)) : "");
  document.querySelectorAll(".op-cmp").forEach(box => {
    if (!window.TVPick) return;
    const kind = box.dataset.kind, bench = box.dataset.bench;
    const res = JSON.parse(box.dataset.res || "{}");
    const errs = JSON.parse(box.dataset.errs || "{}");
    const ia = box.querySelector('[data-cmp="a"]');
    const ib = box.querySelector('[data-cmp="b"]');
    const body = box.querySelector('[data-cmp="body"]');
    const sum = box.querySelector('[data-cmp="sum"]');
    TVPick.load().then(all => {
      const mine = all.filter(r => r.kind === kind);
      if (!mine.length) { body.innerHTML = "<tr><td>The catalogue could not be loaded.</td></tr>"; return; }
      const byKey = k => mine.find(r => r.model_key === k);
      const byName = n => mine.find(r => r.name === n);
      const first = byKey(TVPick.get(kind)) || byKey(box.dataset.a) || mine[0];
      let second = byKey(box.dataset.b) || mine[1];
      if (second === first) second = byKey(box.dataset.a) || mine.find(r => r !== first);
      ia.value = first.name;
      ib.value = second.name;
      const three = (b, r) => {
        const v = res[b]?.[r.model_key];
        return v ? `<small>OLS ${signed(v[0])} · Structural ${signed(v[1])} · GBDT ${signed(v[2])}</small>` : "";
      };
      const errNote = b => {
        const e = errs[b] || {};
        const ks = ["OLS", "Structural L1", "Nonlinear GBDT"].filter(k => e[k] != null);
        return ks.length ? `typical held-out error ${ks.map(k => e[k].toFixed(1) + "%").join(" / ")}` : "";
      };
      const blAssess = r => r.on_blender_residuals
        ? `Assessed: ${esc(r.blender_verdict || "Near prediction")}${three("blender", r)}`
        : `Not assessed<small>${esc(r.blender_reason || "No Blender result")}</small>`;
      const specAssess = r => r.on_residuals
        ? `Assessed: ${esc(r.consensus_verdict || "Near prediction")}${three("spec", r)}`
        : `Not assessed · ${esc(r.coverage_status)}${r.reason ? `<small>${esc(r.reason)}</small>` : ""}`;
      const specScore = r => r.spec_score != null ? num(r.spec_score)
        : (r.measured_value != null ? `${num(r.measured_value)}<small>${esc(r.measured_metric || "")}, not ranked</small>` : "No SPEC result");
      const oems = r => !r.measured_n ? "" : (r.spec_oems ? ` · ${r.spec_oems} OEM${r.spec_oems === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : " · OEM unknown");
      const SECTIONS = {
        blender: [`Blender rendering`, errNote("blender"), [
          ["Blender assessment", blAssess, null],
          ["Blender score", r => r.blender_score != null ? num(r.blender_score) : "No Blender result", "blender_score"],
          ["Blender runs", r => r.blender_runs != null ? r.blender_runs.toLocaleString("en-US") : "0", null],
          ["Blender points per dollar", r => r.score_per_dollar != null ? r.score_per_dollar.toFixed(2) : "—", "score_per_dollar"],
        ]],
        spec: [`SPEC workloads`, errNote("spec"), [
          ["SPEC assessment", specAssess, null],
          [kind === "cpu" ? "SPEC score per socket" : "Calibrated SPEC GWPG score", specScore, "spec_score"],
          ["SPEC disclosures", r => `${r.measured_n || 0}${oems(r)}`, null],
        ]],
      };
      const COMMON = [
        ["Assessment", r => `${esc(r.assessment)}${r.assessed_by ? `<small>by ${esc(r.assessed_by)}</small>` : ""}`, null],
        ["Retail price", r => r.price_usd != null ? `${usd(r.price_usd)}<small>${esc(r.price_date || "")}</small>` : "No current price", "price_usd"],
        ["Value ranking", r => r.value_rank ? `#${r.value_rank} of ${r.value_n}` : "Not ranked", null],
        ["Fair price estimate", r => r.fair_price_usd != null ? `${usd(r.fair_price_usd)}<small>listing ${signed(r.fair_gap_pct)} vs estimate</small>` : "No estimate", null],
      ];
      const draw = () => {
        const a = byName(ia.value), b = byName(ib.value);
        if (!a || !b) { sum.textContent = "Pick two products from the list."; return; }
        const line = ([label, f, col]) => `<tr><td>${label}</td><td>${f(a)}</td><td>${f(b)}</td><td>${col ? diff(a[col], b[col]) : ""}</td></tr>`;
        let html = `<tr><th></th><th>${esc(a.name)}</th><th>${esc(b.name)}</th><th>Second vs first</th></tr>` + COMMON.map(line).join("");
        for (const s of [bench, bench === "spec" ? "blender" : "spec"]) {
          const [title, note, rows] = SECTIONS[s];
          html += `<tr class="op-cmp-sec"><th colspan="4">${title}${note ? `<small>${esc(note)}</small>` : ""}</th></tr>` + rows.map(line).join("");
        }
        body.innerHTML = html;
        const parts = [];
        if (bench === "blender") {
          if (a.blender_score && b.blender_score && a.price_usd && b.price_usd) {
            const s = 100 * (b.blender_score / a.blender_score - 1), p = 100 * (b.price_usd / a.price_usd - 1);
            const v = 100 * (b.score_per_dollar / a.score_per_dollar - 1);
            parts.push(`${esc(b.name)} scores ${Math.abs(s).toFixed(0)}% ${s >= 0 ? "higher" : "lower"} in Blender at ${Math.abs(p).toFixed(0)}% ${p >= 0 ? "more" : "less"} money, so it gives ${Math.abs(v).toFixed(0)}% ${v >= 0 ? "more" : "fewer"} Blender points per dollar.`);
          }
          if (a.on_blender_residuals && b.on_blender_residuals) {
            parts.push(`Against their specifications, ${esc(a.name)} sits ${signed(a.blender_residual_pct)} and ${esc(b.name)} ${signed(b.blender_residual_pct)} against the OLS prediction (${errNote("blender")}).`);
          }
        } else if (a.spec_score != null && b.spec_score != null) {
          const d = 100 * (b.spec_score / a.spec_score - 1);
          parts.push(`On SPEC, ${esc(b.name)} measures ${Math.abs(d).toFixed(0)}% ${d >= 0 ? "higher" : "lower"}.`);
        } else if (a.spec_score != null || b.spec_score != null) {
          parts.push(`Only ${esc((a.spec_score != null ? a : b).name)} has a ranked SPEC result, so SPEC can't compare the two.`);
        } else {
          parts.push("Neither has a ranked SPEC result, so SPEC can't compare the two; the Blender rows below still can.");
        }
        sum.innerHTML = parts.join(" ");
      };
      box._opDraw = () => {
        const f = byKey(TVPick.get(kind));
        if (f && f.name !== ia.value && f.name !== ib.value) ia.value = f.name;
        draw();
      };
      ia.addEventListener("change", draw);
      ib.addEventListener("change", draw);
      draw();
    });
  });
  const settle = () => show(state.kind, state.bench);
  setTimeout(settle, 300);
  window.addEventListener("load", settle);
});
</script>
